summary: A **hybrid** route: solo questing all the way, plus one run of a dungeon only where the run and its quests beat questing. Done solo on a fresh account with no rested XP, it takes about **29 hours /played to 30** and **about 145 hours to 60**. Logging out at an inn every day cuts 10–15 hours. That's slower than the 100–120 hours guide sites project, for an honest reason: about half of the 60 levels' XP here comes from grinding mobs where the route's quests run out (from level 28 on). Each grind step names the mobs and where. 1–30 stays in the Eastern Kingdoms with no boats. 30–40 runs through Hillsbrad, Alterac, Arathi and Stranglethorn. 40–60 goes through Badlands, the new Riverglades, Uldaman, Hinterlands, Tanaris, Un'Goro, Felwood, Winterspring, Burning Steppes and the Plaguelands.
assumptions: **Fresh account.** No Legacy points. If you have **Well Rested**, **Talented** or **Frequent Flier**, you'll be a little ahead of the levels shown.

**Affliction, Imp and drain-tanking.** Launch pets have little health (Nov 2 patch), so the Voidwalker waits until you first reach Stormwind (about level 15.6), and the **Succubus and Felhunter quests are skipped**. If Blizzard buffs pets again, the Voidwalker comes back to level 10–11.

**Each dungeon once, with its quests in your log:** Hall of Thanes, Deadmines, Excavation Site, Gnomeregan, City of Dalaran and Uldaman (the levels assume you run them; if no group forms within about 10 minutes, grind instead). Stockade, Krol'dok and Zul'Farrak are optional. Never repeat a dungeon for XP.
**Quests are skipped on purpose** when they are slow for their XP: long walks, elites your pet can't tank, rare drops. Each section lists what it skips and why.
**Levels are targets, not promises.** Behind? Grind the mobs named in the next grind step. Ahead? Skip steps marked Optional.
**Deathskips** (dying on purpose to respawn at a spirit healer near your next stop) are used a few times early on, where they save a long walk.

**Built from** launch data (the race.aotc.gg leaderboard, Blizzard forums, Nov 4–6), RestedXP's free Forever route for 1–21, beta measurements, Wowhead Forever, guide sites and videos, and the classic Alliance speed routes for 40–60. Every step shows how sure we are and links its sources.

decisions.fork: Get the Voidwalker at 10, or later?
decisions.choice: Later: at about 15.6, the first time you reach Stormwind.
decisions.why: The Nov 2 patch cut pet health from 7.5 to 2 per point of Stamina. At launch the Voidwalker has less health than you, and warlocks stay on the Imp and drain-tank. Waiting also saves a separate trip to Stormwind at 11. **If pets are buffed again**, go back to getting it at 10–11.

decisions.fork: Darkshore, or Westfall and Redridge, for 12–20?
decisions.choice: Stay in the Eastern Kingdoms: Loch Modan, Hall of Thanes, Westfall, Deadmines, Redridge. No boats.
decisions.why: Darkshore has only about 7 new quests, and boats broke on launch day. Beta players reached 20 on Eastern Kingdoms quests plus Hall of Thanes and Deadmines.

decisions.fork: When to run Hall of Thanes?
decisions.choice: At about 14, straight from Loch Modan.
decisions.why: Its quests are level 15–16. The mobs give little XP (a launch full clear gave about three bars), so the run is worth it for its five quests, including **The Treaty of Understanding**. Entering from Loch Modan avoids two tram rides.

decisions.choice: At about 20, before Redridge and Duskwood.
decisions.why: Its quests (17–22) give full XP at 20. It is the busiest dungeon at launch, so groups form fast. Later, Redridge's 21–25 and Duskwood's 25–28 quests are no longer too hard.

Pets are weak at launch, and the Felhunter chain alone has five far-apart stops across two continents. You lose the **Gravestone Scepter** wand too, because Blackfathom Deeps is off the route. Re-check if pets are buffed.

decisions.fork: A Kalimdor loop (Darkshore, Ashenvale, Blackfathom Deeps) at 24–27?
decisions.why: Almost every launch Alliance player at 26–28 was in the Wetlands, Duskwood or Redridge. Boats broke at launch and had 10-minute waits in the beta. The Kalimdor loop only pays off if you want the Gravestone Scepter or the Succubus.

decisions.choice: Optional: only if a group forms within about 10 minutes.
decisions.why: Its quests are worth roughly half to three quarters of a level at 26, which is about the same as questing for the same time. The turn-ins are in Lakeshire and Darkshire, so add that hop if you run it.

decisions.choice: At about 31.6: run the Excavation Site at 30, then finish the level 30–32 Wetlands chains.
decisions.why: The Wetlands has about 30 new Forever quests from 22 to 34. Launch racers who left at 30 came back at 33.8, which is the extra trip this avoids.

decisions.fork: Where to go after the Wetlands?
decisions.choice: Boat Menethil → Southshore. Hillsbrad, Alterac with the City of Dalaran at about 33.5, then Arathi.
decisions.why: That's the order launch Alliance players took (Hillsbrad 32, Alterac 33, Arathi 34). Each City of Dalaran quest is worth about 3,950 XP. You can't fly to Southshore before you've found its flight path, so the boat is the way in.

decisions.fork: Stranglethorn or the new Riverglades for 35–40?
decisions.why: The race leader levelled 35–39 in Stranglethorn, Desolace, Thousand Needles and Swamp of Sorrows, not Riverglades. Riverglades has no quest data anywhere yet, and both factions share its quests. **Switch rule:** if Stranglethorn runs dry before 38.5, go to Riverglades at 38.

decisions.fork: Mount at 40: Felsteed quest or buy riding?
decisions.choice: Felsteed: take the Booty Bay → Ratchet boat, then hearth back.
decisions.why: The Felsteed spell lists no riding requirement, and the trip fits between Stranglethorn and the Badlands. It's unconfirmed whether you still need Apprentice Riding (100 g). If you do, buy it from Binjy at Steelgrill's Depot instead.

decisions.choice: Badlands at 40–40.7, walk into Riverglades, then Uldaman at about 44.5.
decisions.why: The Badlands quests (38–42) give full XP at 40 and lose value fast after that. Farholde Keep in Riverglades is one flight from Thelsamar. Uldaman's quests are worth about two thirds of a level at 45. **Switch rule:** under ~35k XP an hour in Riverglades, go to Swamp of Sorrows and Stranglethorn instead.

decisions.choice: Hinterlands at 45–47.5, then the new Powderfuse Port → Tanaris boat.
decisions.why: Aerie Peak connects to Ironforge, Southshore and Refuge Pointe. The new boat from Riverglades lands next to Tanaris, and there's no Alliance warlock trainer on Kalimdor. Run Zul'Farrak only if you hold four or more of its quests.

decisions.fork: Feralas, or Un'Goro, Felwood and Winterspring?
decisions.choice: Skip Feralas. Un'Goro, one training trip home, Felwood, Winterspring; leave Kalimdor at 55.
decisions.why: Feralas (43–47) is out-levelled by the time you reach Kalimdor. Kalimdor's flight paths have to be found on foot, so the route crosses it once.

decisions.fork: Shen'dralas and the Cozy Sleeping Bag?
decisions.why: Shen'dralas needs Honored with the Magram centaurs and has no flight path. The Sleeping Bag chain sends you through the Horde-held Barrens and a PvP-camped dam for about 3% XP.

legs.title: Coldridge Valley & Dun Morogh
legs.summary: Start at Anvilmar, get your Imp from the Feather Charm quest, and clear Coldridge Valley by about 5.6. Then make Kharanos your base: camping and cooking intro, the Grizzled Den, the new Misty Pine Refuge quests, and two loops through Brewnall, using deaths to get back to Kharanos fast. Finish at 10.3 with Blood Pact on your Imp and the leg-2 quests in your log.
legs.why: The backbone is RestedXP's launch-maintained Forever 1–11 Dwarf/Gnome route (community, launch), which already uses the new Kharanos quests and deathskips. Three changes make it faster for this leg. (1) Misty Pine (5 quests, ~2,350 quest XP: foreverdb launch data) right after the Depot turn-ins at ~7.1, when its level 7–8 mobs are still yellow. Forever cut XP from green low-level mobs (beta), and the Depot is already on the way. (2) Frosthowl (775 XP) is accepted in Brewnall on the first western pass and killed on the second, when you walk past the Grizzled Den anyway. (3) The end-of-leg grind is done on Leper Gnomes (8–10, yellow) with Operation Recombobulation (850 XP) instead of on RestedXP's level 7–8 beasts. Misty Pine and Frosthowl replace most of RestedXP's beast grind. By the Classic XP curve (Forever keeps it), the turn-ins plus the kills they require come to ~26k of the ~29.9k XP to 10.3; the Leper Gnome block covers the rest. Gnomes are the least-played Alliance race at launch, so Coldridge and Kharanos are among the quieter Alliance starts (community, launch). Data Hoarders is left out because it can only be accepted in Ironforge.
legs.estTime: 2.0–2.4 h /played (estimate). The beta 1–10 warlock personal best of 1:29 used bugged instant wands, and a relaxed beta warrior took 2:05 to 10.
legs.start: Level 1, Anvilmar (Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh). Hearth: Coldridge Valley (default). No quests, no flight paths, no pet.
legs.end: Level 10.3, Steelgrill's Depot (Kharanos), 1 min from the inn. Hearth: Thunderbrew Distillery. Trained 10 at Gimrizz Shadowcog. Pet: Imp with Blood Pact. Carrying: The Reports (291, to Ironforge), Shimmer Stout (413, to Mountaineer Barleybrew at the South Gate, who gives Stout to Kadrell 414), A Visitor to Dun Morogh (96408). Camping 101: Cooking is turned in; if it is still in your log, never abandon it. Data Hoarders not taken: it starts in Ironforge. No flight paths.

skipped.name: Data Hoarders
skipped.why: Starts at Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge (foreverdb launch data; a beta tester asked for it to start in Kharanos), but its cards are back near Gnomeregan (Dun Morogh 24–28, 36–44). Taking it in Ironforge means a return trip.

skipped.name: Protecting the Herd
skipped.why: Level-12 quest (900 XP) to kill Vagash, a level-11 elite yeti at Amberstill Ranch, east of this leg. A beta level-10 paladin needed every cooldown, but RestedXP (launch) has every non-hunter kite him to the ranch guard and do 51%+ of the damage. Leg 2 passes the ranch and decides.

skipped.name: The Quarry's Smith
skipped.why: Needs 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides.

skipped.name: Never Saddle on Quality
skipped.why: 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts with an unknown drop rate.

skipped.name: A New Threat
skipped.why: Low XP (170). RestedXP leaves it out for warlocks, whose Imp quest uses the same time.

skipped.name: A Refugee's Quandary
skipped.why: 250 XP for three boxes in different corners of the valley. RestedXP leaves it out for warlocks.

skipped.name: Rejold's New Brew
skipped.why: Talk quest that only leads further from the route; guides list it as skippable.

skipped.name: Exploration / flight-path openers
skipped.why: Human/Elwynn-based (level 5 in ~36 min with no kills) and no Imp quest, so not faster for a gnome. Use only if Coldridge is unplayably crowded.

steps.text: Accept **Dwarven Outfitters** from Sten Stoutarm outside Anvilmar
Kill Ragged Young Wolves until you have about 10 copper of loot; take off your starter clothes
steps.note: Immolate costs money at level 1. RestedXP sells the four Acolyte cloth pieces for 4 copper to afford it.

steps.text: Sell the loot and starter clothes to Grundel Harkin inside Anvilmar
Train **Immolate** and accept **Beginnings** from Alamar Grimm upstairs
steps.note: Optional RestedXP trick: hearth from up here back to Coldridge Valley instead of walking out.

steps.text: Kill Ragged Young Wolves for 8 Tough Wolf Meat and reach level 2
Sell junk and buy 15 Refreshing Spring Water from Adlin Pridedrift
steps.note: Water is your mana between pulls until Life Tap at 6.

steps.text: Turn in **Dwarven Outfitters**; accept **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery** and **Tainted Memorandum**
steps.note: Tainted Memorandum is the gnome warlock letter. It is turned in together with Beginnings.

steps.text: Accept **The Troll Cave** from Grelin Whitebeard on the way to the cave
steps.note: RestedXP gives warlocks this early so whelps killed near the cave already count.

steps.text: Enter the troll cave and kill Frostmane Novices for 3 Feather Charms
steps.note: Cave entrance at 27.1, 80.7 (RestedXP).

steps.text: Deathskip (die on purpose): die in the cave and release to the Coldridge Valley spirit healer
steps.note: Your subzone must say Coldridge Valley when you die, or you respawn in Kharanos (RestedXP). Under level 10 there is no resurrection sickness.

steps.text: Turn in **Beginnings** and **Tainted Memorandum** to Alamar Grimm; summon your Imp
steps.note: Keep the Imp for the whole leg: launch pets have little health, so the Voidwalker waits until ~15.6.

steps.text: Turn in **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery**; accept **The Boar Hunter** and the next **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery**
Kill 12 Small Crag Boars around Talin
Turn in **The Boar Hunter** to Talin Keeneye
Grind boars and wolves toward Grelin until at least 1,130/1,400 XP into level 3
steps.note: Not optional: 1,130 + 270 XP from the Mail Delivery turn-in is exactly level 4, which Scalding Mornbrew requires. Skip only if you are already past 1,130.

steps.text: Turn in **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery** (this dings 4); accept **Scalding Mornbrew Delivery** from Nori next to Grelin

npcs.name: Nori Pridedrift
npcs.note: foreverdb launch data; no Wowhead id checked

steps.note: Scalding Mornbrew needs level 4. It has a 5-minute timer: run straight to Anvilmar and do not go AFK.

steps.text: Turn in **Scalding Mornbrew Delivery** to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar; accept **Bring Back the Mug**
Train level 4 (Corruption, Curse of Weakness) at Alamar Grimm
steps.note: If you still carry Tainted Memorandum, turn it in here too.

steps.text: Accept **Grund and Gozwin** from Grund Drokda at the Anvilmar door
steps.note: New Forever quest (410 XP at level 4–5).

steps.text: At the camp in the north-west hills, kill the Snow Leopard Prowler and loot Gozwin's Mechanic's Log
steps.note: The Prowler respawns very fast at launch: grab the log even if someone else is on the cat.

steps.text: Turn in **Bring Back the Mug** to Nori Pridedrift

npcs.name: Nori Pridedrift
npcs.note: foreverdb launch data; no Wowhead id checked

steps.note: 450 XP for a walk you make anyway.

steps.text: Kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps south and west of Grelin
Turn in **The Troll Cave**; accept **The Stolen Journal**
Kill Grik'nir the Cold at the back of the troll cave; loot Grelin's journal
Turn in **The Stolen Journal**; accept **Senir's Observations**
Turn in **Grund and Gozwin** to Grund Drokda
steps.note: Reward: Canvas Latchbag, a 6-slot bag.

steps.text: At the tunnel: turn in **Senir's Observations**; accept **Senir's Observations**, **The Adventurer** and **Supplies to Tannok**
steps.note: The Adventurer (new) starts the camping chain in Kharanos.

steps.text: Run through Coldridge Pass, killing Crag Boars; keep every Chunk of Boar Meat and Crag Boar Rib
steps.note: Meat feeds Stocking Jetsteam and your XP food; ribs are for Beer Basted Boar Ribs. RestedXP target: 1,595/2,800 XP into 5.

steps.text: Deathskip once out of the tunnel: die and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Make sure your subzone is no longer Coldridge Pass, or you respawn back in the valley (RestedXP).

steps.text: Turn in **The Adventurer**; accept **The Great Outdoors** from Eric Brighthammer
Type /sit at Eric's campfire, wait for Boosted Rest, then type /sit again
steps.note: Launch bug: the sit objective needs the typed /sit, a second time while already seated, and no NPC targeted.

steps.text: Turn in **The Great Outdoors**; accept **Camping 101: Cooking**
steps.note: Never abandon Camping 101: Cooking. An abandoned copy cannot be taken again.

steps.text: Turn in **Senir's Observations**; accept **Secure the Mountain** from Senir Whitebeard
Accept **Beer Basted Boar Ribs** from Ragnar Thunderbrew outside the distillery
In the distillery: turn in **Supplies to Tannok**; accept **Dawn in the Mountains** from Maxan Anvol
steps.note: Dawn in the Mountains opens the Misty Pine quests (all level 8).

steps.text: Train Cooking with Gremlock Pilsnor and turn in **Camping 101: Cooking**
steps.note: Costs 1 silver (RestedXP). If you are short, keep the quest and finish it on your next Kharanos stop; never abandon it.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Belm (Thunderbrew Distillery); buy a few Ice Cold Milk if spare
steps.note: Every deathskip in this leg lands you in Kharanos anyway; the bind is for leg 2.

steps.text: Train 6 (Life Tap, Shadow Bolt) at Gimrizz Shadowcog; buy the **Grimoire of Blood Pact** from Dannie Fizzwizzle
steps.note: Blood Pact gives you Stamina from the Imp. If money is short, buy the grimoire on the next Kharanos stop.

steps.text: Accept **Tools for Steelgrill** (Tharek Blackstone) and **Flintfire's Shipment** (Tognus Flintfire) at the forge
Steelgrill's Depot: turn in **Tools for Steelgrill**; accept **Stocking Jetsteam**, **The Grizzled Den** and **Ammo for Rumbleshot**
Walk to Gretchen killing boars and Young Black Bears for meat, ribs and 2 Thick Bear Fur
steps.note: Keep 4 meat for Stocking Jetsteam and every extra chunk for XP food.

steps.text: Open the crate next to Mountaineer Gretchen for Rumbleshot's Ammo
Turn in **Secure the Mountain**; accept the next **Secure the Mountain** (find Cornelius)
Grizzled Den: 8 Wendigo Manes, 8 Flintfire's Shipments, and find Mountaineer Cornelius
steps.note: Cornelius' body is at 43.0, 49.5. The cave hyperspawns at launch: pull singly, never rest inside, and leave Frosthowl (39.6, 48.6) for later.

steps.text: Deathskip: die in the den and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: RestedXP does this instead of walking out of the cave.

steps.text: If still missing, kill Young Black Bears south of Kharanos for Thick Bear Fur
Turn in **Flintfire's Shipment** to Tognus Flintfire; repair at Gamili Frosthide beside him
steps.note: 625 XP plus reputation. Each deathskip costs durability (10% for dying, 25% more for the spirit-healer rez), so repair here if your gear shows yellow.

steps.text: Cook spare boar meat into Roasted Boar Meat at Eric's campfire; eat one before each kill block

items.name: Basic Campfire
items.note: needs Simple Wood + Flint and Tinder; "allows cooking"

steps.note: Well Fed: +5% kill XP for 15 min if you sit 10 s while eating; boar meat cooks at Cooking 1, wolf meat needs 10. If Eric's fire will not cook, buy Simple Wood and Flint and Tinder from Kreg Bilmn and cast Basic Campfire.

steps.text: At the Depot: turn in **The Grizzled Den** and **Stocking Jetsteam**; accept **Evershine**
Follow the road east to Misty Pine Refuge
steps.note: About 1 min from the Depot. Its mobs are level 7–8, so they are yellow (full XP) now and turn green (reduced XP) if you leave this for later.

steps.text: Turn in **Dawn in the Mountains**; accept **Finding Warmth** from Father Gavin
steps.note: Finding Warmth must be done first: Gavin's other quests only appear after it.

steps.text: Loot 14 Mostly Dry Firewood from Fallen Logs around the refuge
steps.note: If logs are taken, more lie south (56–60, 52–59) and along the road (50–53, 50–52).

steps.text: Turn in **Finding Warmth**; accept **Rime's Wrath** and **Treacherous Cold**
Kill the Minor Ice Elementals around the refuge as you head south
Loot Sunhammer's Rifle from the fallen mountaineer south-east of the refuge
steps.note: The bodies are hard to see in the fog; go to the exact spot.

steps.text: Loot Stoneanvil's Rifle south of the road
steps.note: The farthest rifle. The beta "no loot" bug was fixed in the dev notes.

steps.text: Head north: loot Coalbeard's Rifle and finish the 10 Minor Ice Elementals
Turn in **Rime's Wrath** and **Treacherous Cold**; accept **Rime's Wrath** (part 2)
Kill Avala just north of the refuge and loot Avala's Core
steps.note: Let the Imp and your damage-over-time spells do the work; Frost Armor punishes melee.

steps.text: Turn in **Rime's Wrath** to Father Gavin
steps.note: 700 XP. Misty Pine is done: walk back west.

steps.text: Passing Kharanos, accept **Operation Recombobulation** (Razzle) and **Frostmane Hold** (Senir Whitebeard)
steps.note: Both need level 7, so Razzle waits until now (about a 15-second detour to the north-west edge of town). Also buy the Blood Pact grimoire if you skipped it, and cook more boar meat.

steps.text: Turn in **Secure the Mountain**; accept **Secure the Mountain** (the report for Senir)
Turn in **Ammo for Rumbleshot** to Hegnar Rumbleshot
Accept **Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash** from Tundra MacGrann
steps.note: Done on the second western pass, once you have Fear.

steps.text: In Brewnall, buy Ice Cold Milk from Keeg Gibn if you are low on drinks
Turn in **Evershine**; accept **A Favor for Evershine**, **The Perfect Stout**, **Bitter Rivals** and **Frosthowl**
steps.note: Frosthowl (new, 775 XP) is from Gretta Ganter at 31.4, 44.6.

steps.text: Loop Brewnall for 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars and 8 Snow Leopards; finish the ribs
steps.note: RestedXP loop: 31.2, 39.2 → 27.9, 45.6 → 29.4, 50.1 → 31.7, 46.8. Eat boar meat first.

steps.text: Turn in **A Favor for Evershine**; accept **Return to Bellowfiz**
steps.note: Return to Bellowfiz (875 XP) stays in your log until the end of the leg.

steps.text: Frostmane Hold: kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters and explore the cave, keeping to the left
steps.note: RestedXP: run up the side of the entrance and drop in. The rare Great Father Arctikus (11) spawns here.

steps.text: Deathskip: die in Frostmane Hold and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Saves the 3-minute walk back east (RestedXP).

steps.text: Turn in **Secure the Mountain** and **Frostmane Hold** to Senir Whitebeard
Buy one Rhapsody Malt and one Thunder Ale from Innkeeper Belm
steps.note: The malt is for Beer Basted Boar Ribs, the ale distracts Jarven.

steps.text: Downstairs: accept and turn in **Distracting Jarven** (hand over the Thunder Ale), then click the barrel for **Bitter Rivals**
steps.note: Jarven offers Distracting Jarven when you talk to him; with the ale in your bags you hand it in at once. The barrel then completes Bitter Rivals and starts Return to Marleth.

steps.text: Train 8 (Bane of Agony, Fear) at Gimrizz Shadowcog
steps.note: You need Fear for Old Icebeard on the next pass.

steps.text: Turn in **Beer Basted Boar Ribs** to Ragnar Thunderbrew; cook more boar meat
In the Grizzled Den, kill Frosthowl in the north-west chamber and loot the Sack of Fish
steps.note: Beta players found Frosthowl hard to tag; at launch the den hyperspawns. Fear any add.

steps.text: Climb to Shimmer Ridge; kill Frostmane Seers and open Shimmerweed Baskets for 6 Shimmerweed
steps.note: Path up the slope at 42.9, 45.2 (RestedXP). If the south end is busy, more seers and baskets sit at 41–43, 34–37.

steps.text: In Old Icebeard's cave, Fear the yeti and loot MacGrann's Meat Locker
steps.note: RestedXP warlock trick: Fear him as he comes, loot, and walk out.

steps.text: Turn in **Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash**
steps.note: Level 12 quest, so it pays full XP.

steps.text: Brewnall: turn in **Frosthowl**, **The Perfect Stout** and **Return to Marleth**; accept **Shimmer Stout**

items.name: Frosthowl's Footwarmers
items.note: leather: a warlock cannot wear it, so sell it

steps.note: Shimmer Stout is carried into leg 2 (Mountaineer Barleybrew at the South Gate).

steps.text: Leper Gnomes north-west of Brewnall: get 8 Cogs and 8 Gears, then grind to 550 XP into level 10
steps.note: Yellow mobs at 9–10; eat boar meat. Replaces RestedXP's beast-loop gate (4,525/5,400 into 8), which is already passed here.

steps.text: Deathskip: die and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Still free at 10: resurrection sickness starts above level 10 (wiki, Classic rule assumed for Forever). The rez only costs durability.

steps.text: Accept **The Reports** from Senir Whitebeard
steps.note: Turned in to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge (leg 2).

steps.text: Train 10 (Drain Soul, Create Healthstone) at Gimrizz Shadowcog
steps.note: Skip the Voidwalker for now: launch pets were cut to 2 HP per Stamina, so it waits for Stormwind at ~15.6.

steps.text: Turn in **Operation Recombobulation** to Razzle Sprysprocket
At the Depot: turn in **Return to Bellowfiz**; accept **A Visitor to Dun Morogh** from Beldin Steelgrill
steps.note: 875 XP. A Visitor to Dun Morogh starts the Hall of Thanes chain in leg 2.

steps.text: Level 10.3 at Steelgrill's Depot, hearth on Thunderbrew Distillery; head east for Gol'Bolar (leg 2)
steps.note: If you are below 10.3, the next leg absorbs it in Gol'Bolar; do not grind more here.

openQuestions: Data Hoarders: the skeleton has it done in this leg, but foreverdb launch data shows it starting at Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge (68.1, 44.5), and a beta tester confirms it can't be taken in Kharanos. Leg 2 should not expect it, or should decide whether a Gnomeregan return is worth it (XP unknown).
Hand-off: we carry Shimmer Stout (413), not Stout to Kadrell (414). The first is turned in at Mountaineer Barleybrew (South Gate, Dun Morogh 86.2, 48.8), who then gives 414.

Camping 101: Cooking: RestedXP turns it in right away at Gremlock Pilsnor (270 XP, it unlocks the campfire recipe). The skeleton's end state has it still in the log. This leg turns it in unless the player can't afford Cooking's 1 silver.
Leper Gnome cog and gear drop rates in Forever are unmeasured. If 8 + 8 takes more than ~15 min, abandon Operation Recombobulation and grind Frostmane Hold trolls (8–10) instead.
Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash (level 12) has no recorded XP in Forever yet; the level model assumes ~900.

Respawn of the Kharanos spirit healer: deathskips assume RestedXP's behaviour (respawn at Kharanos from anywhere west of Coldridge Pass). The Kharanos graveyard position was not checked in a database.
Can Roasted Boar Meat be cooked at Eric's Basic Campfire, or do you need your own Basic Campfire (Simple Wood + Flint and Tinder)? Not verified.
Level estimates use the Classic XP curve, foreverdb launch quest XP and guessed kill XP; check them on a real run.

Misty Pine (Finding Warmth, Rime's Wrath, Treacherous Cold) has no recorded minimum level. Other new level-8 Dun Morogh quests (Dawn in the Mountains, Secure the Mountain) were taken at level 5 (foreverdb), so arriving at 7.1 should work. If Father Gavin offers nothing, play the Brewnall loop first and do Misty Pine on the way east in leg 2.

ForeverDB minimum levels (Scalding Mornbrew 4, Operation Recombobulation 7, Frostmane Hold 7, Tundra MacGrann 7, Shimmer Stout 8) are Classic reference data. RestedXP's launch-maintained 1,130/1,400 gate before Scalding Mornbrew suggests they still hold in Forever.
Distracting Jarven (308) has no ForeverDB page, so its Forever XP is unknown (small in Classic).
Durability loss from the five deathskips is the Classic rule (10% per death plus 25% for a spirit-healer rez). Nobody has reported whether low-level Forever characters are exempt.

legs.title: Gol'Bolar, Loch Modan, Hall of Thanes, Voidwalker & Westfall
legs.summary: Finish east Dun Morogh and the Hall of Thanes key quests, then quest west Loch Modan with a quick flight to Ironforge at 12 to train Shadow Bolt rank 3. Fly back to Ironforge at 14 for one Hall of Thanes run with all five quests, take the tram to Stormwind for the Voidwalker via Brackwell and Lakeshire (for its flight path), bind Stormwind, and quest Westfall from Sentinel Hill.
legs.why: Loch Modan is used instead of RestedXP's Elwynn swing at 11 because the Nov 2 pet nerf made the Voidwalker weak (250-395 HP), so the class quest waits until you pass Stormwind anyway (skeleton fork F1; https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2401991). Hall of Thanes is run straight from Loch Modan: its five quests pay about 13,300 XP (warcraft.wiki.gg values), all require only level 9-10, and the launch mob XP is small ('3 bars', https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2402437), so one run with every quest is the whole point. Loch Modan follows RestedXP's launch-maintained 12-14 route with two changes. At 12.05 you bind Thelsamar, fly to Ironforge, train level 12 (Shadow Bolt rank 3 hits 40-46 instead of 22-27, https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=705) and hearth back, which also pays Return to Brock (1,050 XP). The grind gate sits at the mouth of Stonesplinter Valley, where In Defense of the King's Lands part 2 (237, 1,050 XP at launch, https://foreverdb.net/quest/237) pays for the same Skullthumpers and Seers. The bunker, that grind spot and the Snowbound snow patch are all within a minute of each other. Stormwind, Elwynn and Lakeshire are one loop that collects three flight paths, the level-14 spells (Slaughtered Lamb) and the Voidwalker without a separate trip. Westfall is done in three loops ordered by its quest gates: Toxic Soil step 3 needs steps 1-2, step 4 needs step 3, and People's Militia part 3 needs part 2. Leaving the Toxic Soil chain at Moonbrook Espionage avoids the Rough Dynamite and Stormwind detour.
legs.estTime: 6.3-7.3 h /played (estimate; the skeleton budgeted 5.8 h, and our XP model still needs ~1 h of grinding in Westfall to reach 18.3)
legs.start: Level 10.3, Steelgrill's Depot (Kharanos). Hearth: Thunderbrew Distillery. Trained 10. Pet: Imp with Blood Pact. Carrying: A Visitor to Dun Morogh (96408), Shimmer Stout (413, becomes Stout to Kadrell 414 at South Gate Pass), The Reports (291). No flight paths.
legs.end: Level 18.3, Sentinel Hill (Westfall). Hearth: Stormwind (bound at ~15.4; the Thelsamar bind at 12.05 is overwritten). Pets: Imp + Voidwalker. Trained 12 (Ironforge, at 12.1) and 14 (Stormwind, Slaughtered Lamb). Level 16 (Life Tap rank 2, Unending Breath) is reached in Westfall with no trainer on the way, so train 16 and 18 together at leg 3's Stormwind stop. Flight paths: Thelsamar, Ironforge, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill. Carrying: The Defias Brotherhood (65, to Wiley in Lakeshire); Oh Brother... (167); Collecting Memories (168); Underground Assault (2040); optionally Humble Beginnings (399, compass looted). Red Silk Bandanas (214) is NOT available yet: it needs The Defias Brotherhood step 155. Done: Hall of Thanes (all 5 quests); Toxic Soil up to Moonbrook Espionage (92747); People's Militia 1-3; Keeper of the Flame; Encroaching Gnolls (handed in on the Lakeshire walk); Harvesting the Harvesters only if the drops came.

steps.text: Enter the quarry mine and kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers

openQuestions: XP model: with Classic quest XP (Questie's xpDB) and estimated kill XP, the quests in this leg end at about 17.25 after the lighthouse. Reaching 18.3 needs ~17,000 XP of grinding (60-80 min; the verifier changes in Loch Modan do not shrink it, because they only replace Loch Modan grinding). Consider ending leg 2 at ~17.3 and starting leg 3's Redridge first pass (its quests are 15-18) instead of grinding.

Red Silk Bandanas (214) requires The Defias Brotherhood step 155 (Questie Forever DB preQuestSingle; RestedXP accepts it right after 155), so the skeleton's end state '214 partly done' is impossible. Leg 3 should accept it after the Defias Traitor escort.

Level 16 adds Life Tap rank 2 as well as Unending Breath (Wowhead Forever spell tooltips: spell=1455, spell=5697). You reach 16 in Westfall with no trainer on the way, so leg 3's Stormwind stop (dr-014, which lists only 18) should train 16 and 18 together.
Hall of Thanes is entered at ~14.0, not 14.4: warcraft.wiki.gg lists required level 9-10 for all five quests, so the refusal risk is gone. Enter higher only if your group asks for it.

Harvesting the Harvesters: RestedXP's launch guide skips step 1 (drop rate 'beyond dreadful, over 50 kills'), and Questie's Forever corrections list Engineering 1 for step 2 (92910). The skeleton's 'Harvesters 1-2 done' is unlikely for a non-engineer.
Banner of the Fallen (86585) and Excavation Tools (86613): no launch player or guide routes them; foreverdb lists them as levels 17 and 18; Headsplitter is level 15-17 in a cave.
No Wowhead NPC ids found for Grenhild Darktalon (Snowbound giver) and Norric Lochthane (Snowbound turn-in); coordinates come from RestedXP's launch guide.

Unknown Forever XP: Snowbound, Silver of the Waves, Banner of the Fallen, Return to Brock (Classic 1,050 assumed), Moonbrook Espionage and People's Militia part 3. ForeverDB's launch logs cover the rest of the Dun Morogh and Westfall quests used here; the Stolen Blasting Powder pair paid 85 + 850.
Encroaching Gnolls (244) is done here on the walk to Lakeshire. Resolved by the route critic: leg 3 no longer repeats it (dr-020, dr-029).
The Forgotten Heirloom: the Oct 1 note says the watch's 'respawn rate' was 'significantly reduced', which can mean slower or faster. If players are waiting at the wardrobe, skip it.
Surena's Choker drops 38% of the time (Wowhead); at launch many warlocks may be camping her.
Stormwind coordinates use the Forever map values from Questie's converted data (they match Wowhead's second coordinate set); RestedXP's own percentages for Stormwind are Classic-map values.
People's Militia parts 2-3 and Keeper of the Flame are additions to the skeleton plan, used to replace part of the grind.

Hall of Thanes timing: RestedXP's launch dungeon guide runs it at 17-18, and RestedXP's Loch Modan guide says to skip its trogg grind gate if you will run the dungeon later. This leg runs it at 14.0 straight from Loch Modan because a beta group of 13-15s cleared it (https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2356140). If launch groups at 14 wipe, do Westfall first and take the tram back at ~17.

Early Ironforge hop (verifier change): costs one flight (~2 min, estimate) plus ~1 min of walking and the hearth; it pays Return to Brock (1,050 XP), removes ~2,000 XP of grinding and gives Shadow Bolt rank 3 for the Loch Modan fights. Nobody has timed it in Forever.

legs.title: Defias chain, Deadmines & Redridge
legs.summary: Follow the Defias Brotherhood chain between Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill and Stormwind, doing Redridge's easy quests on the two Lakeshire stops, and run the Deadmines once at about 19.7 with all five quests. After the Stormwind hand-ins and level-20 training, kill Bellygrub next to Lakeshire, clear Redridge's level 20–25 quests in an east loop and a north loop (with Keeshan's escort), grind to 23.5, then walk to Darkshire for its flight path.
legs.why: The Defias chain fixes the skeleton of this leg: Wiley in Lakeshire, Gryan at Sentinel Hill, Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, back to Gryan, then the Deadmines (Wowhead Forever DB). Two cheap additions ride on it. (1) Walking Stormwind → Goldshire → Three Corners instead of flying, as RestedXP's launch speed route does, picks up The Price of Shoes chain, which unlocks Underbelly Scales, A Baying of Gnolls and Howling in the Hills, and passes Guard Parker. (2) The Messenger chain (120 → 121 → 143 → 144) uses stops you make anyway and is required for Messenger to Darkshire (ForeverDB lists 144 as its prerequisite). Redridge's level 15–20 quests are done on the two Lakeshire stops before the run, while they still pay full XP, so you enter the Deadmines at about 19.7. That matches RestedXP's launch dungeon route (Deadmines at 19–20). Deadmines is the busiest dungeon at launch (60.tools), and its five quests are worth about 15,750 XP in Forever (Method gives 18,450 for six, one of them a new 2,700-XP quest this leg skips; 99% of a level at 18 per Cyranis in beta). The level 20–25 Redridge quests follow in two loops that never backtrack: east (Alther's Mill, Galardell Valley, Render's Valley) and north (Yowler, Rethban Caverns). Launch players' addon data on ForeverDB shows Redridge quests paying their Classic amounts (Assessing the Threat 950, The Everstill Bridge 1,550, Blackrock Menace 1,650, Solomon's Law 1,850, Blackrock Bounty 2,000). Two cheap quests the skeleton skipped are back in: An Unwelcome Guest (Bellygrub is a normal level-24 boar that patrols to Lakeshire's west edge, and RestedXP's launch speed route kills him solo) and Missing In Action (Keeshan waits in the cave you grind anyway). Even so, Redridge's quests run out at about 21.7, so this leg needs two grind blocks (~48k XP, about 290 kills) to reach the skeleton's 23.5; see the open questions for ways to cut them. ForeverDB's launch coordinates also settle the skeleton's map warning: Forever uses the re-cut Redridge map (about 5 lower in x) and the harbor-era Stormwind map, and every coordinate here uses those sets.
legs.estTime: 7–8 h /played (estimate): Redridge before the run ~1 h, Defias chain and travel ~0.7 h, Deadmines with group-finding ~1.2 h, Stormwind ~0.2 h, Redridge quests after the run ~1.8 h, grinding ~2–3 h (48k XP at 24k XP/h for a well-played warlock; 3 h at the 15.8k XP/h one beta player measured). Cutting the grind (open questions) brings it back near 5.5 h.
legs.start: Level 18.3, Sentinel Hill (Westfall). Hearth: Stormwind (bound at ~15.4). Pets: Imp + Voidwalker. Trained 12 (Ironforge) and 14 (Stormwind); 16 was skipped in leg 2, so train 16 and 18 at this leg's first Stormwind stop. Flight paths: Thelsamar, Ironforge, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill. Carrying: The Defias Brotherhood (65, to Wiley in Lakeshire); Oh Brother… (167); Collecting Memories (168); Underground Assault (2040); optionally Humble Beginnings (399, compass looted). Red Silk Bandanas (214) is not available yet (it opens after the Defias Traitor escort). Done: Hall of Thanes (all 5 quests); Toxic Soil up to Moonbrook Espionage (92747); The People's Militia 1–3; Keeper of the Flame; Encroaching Gnolls; Harvesting the Harvesters only if its drops came.
legs.end: Level 23.5, Darkshire (Duskwood); Darkshire flight path learned. Hearth: Stormwind. Trained 16, 18 and 20 (Stormwind). Pets: Imp + Voidwalker. Carrying: Messenger to Darkshire (145; turn in to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire 71.8, 46.4); What Comes Around… (386, Stockade; hand back to Guard Berton in Lakeshire); Bazil Thredd (389, Stockade; to Warden Thelwater). Done: the Defias chain, the Deadmines (5 quests), The Unsent Letter → Baros Alexston, the Messenger chain to 144, An Unwelcome Guest, Missing In Action, and every Redridge quest except the skips below.

openQuestions: XP gap (biggest issue, for the judge): even with An Unwelcome Guest (1,950, logged) and Missing In Action (~2,200, Classic amount) added, Redridge's quests run out at about 21.7. The two grind blocks total ~48k XP (18k in Galardell Valley, 30k at Rethban), i.e. 2–3 h. Options: (a) end leg 3 at ~21.7 and start Duskwood there: its quests still pay full XP, a fixed XP shortfall is ~15–20% cheaper to grind later because kill XP grows with level, and later legs may have spare quests; (b) the Stockade from Lakeshire at 22 is a poor fit: its trash is level 23–25 elite and Bazil Thredd is a level-29 elite (Wowhead Forever), Method rates it 25–29; (c) the Toxic Soil → Destruction in Deadmines chain (Method: the new Deadmines quest pays 2,700) would add XP if leg 2 keeps Explosive Consultation, but its middle steps (A Dynamite Plan, Detonation at a Distance ×2) are unmapped.

Deadmines quest XP: Method's 18,450 is for six quests including the new 2,700-XP one (Destruction in Deadmines), which this leg skips, so the five done here are ~15,750. ConquestCapped gives 6,175 for the last Defias step and 12,825 for the three core quests, so Red Silk Bandanas + Underground Assault ≈ 6,650 between them. Oh Brother… (1,550) and Collecting Memories (1,350) were logged at launch with no dungeon bonus. Post-Nov 2 values for 166, 214, 2040 and 373 are not logged yet.

Alther's Mill (98386): ForeverDB still has no data. Wowhead's Forever series puts it in the same tier as Blackrock Menace and Blackrock Blockade (then Tharil'zun), so it should be offered with them; its text names Foreman Oslow, but the giver isn't logged. Oslow and Marris stand together at the north end of the bridge, so either way it's the same stop.

An Unsent Letter drops 56% of the time from VanCleef (Wowhead). Unknown: whether everyone in the group can loot it in Forever. Without it, there's no Bazil Thredd for leg 4. Likewise the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket (Sneed's Shredder, 47%) gates Underground Assault.
Leave-group trick: launch guides say you land at the nearest graveyard, but which Westfall graveyard the Deadmines uses isn't confirmed.

Bellygrub is back in on two sources: Wowhead's Forever tooltip (level 24, Normal) and RestedXP's launch speed route, which kills him solo at ~19; only one launch player has logged the quest (1,950 XP at 20). If he turns out to be elite, skip it and add ~2k XP to the Rethban grind.

Missing In Action: the escort itself is unverified in Forever (theory). Wowhead's Keeshan waypoints run from about 26, 9.6 toward 38, 18, so he may leave by an eastern exit; the hand-in at Marshal Marris was seen by 2 launch players (ForeverDB).
Flight time Sentinel Hill ↔ Lakeshire isn't logged at launch (assumed 2–3 min). Stormwind → Lakeshire is 1:53 (ForeverDB).

legs.title: Duskwood, Stormwind (optional Stockade) & Wetlands
legs.summary: Quest Duskwood from Darkshire in three short loops (south-east cemetery, Raven Hill in the west, the worgen and ghost to the north-east), then fly to Stormwind to train and try for a Stockade group. Walk into the Wetlands from Thelsamar through Dun Algaz, set up in Menethil, and work the Menethil, Whelgar, Howin and Greenwarden chains until you stand at the Excavation Site at level 30 with its quests in your log.
legs.why: Duskwood's level 20–28 quests are on level at 23.5–25 and its hubs are flight-linked, matching launch racers who were in Redridge and Duskwood at 26–27 before the Wetlands (race.aotc.gg). A Darkshire bind lets you hearth back from Raven Hill instead of running 4 minutes across the zone. The chains that bounce between the two ends of the zone (Stalvan, Shadowy Figure, Abercrombie) are cut; RestedXP's Classic route needs three visits for them. Ira's Dagger starts from a 100% drop on the Lost Stalker ghost, and both of its wolves spawn around that ghost (Wowhead Forever), so the new Forever quest costs one short loop. The Stockade stays optional: Forever pays about twice Classic for its quests (ForeverDB: 5,550 XP for Quell the Uprising at 24). The Wetlands is the launch zone for Alliance 27–30 (62 of 94 samples; the only Gnome Warlock went 27.1→30.1 there). Menethil can't be flown to before you discover it, so you walk in through Dun Algaz and pick up The Algaz Gauntlet, Tramping Paws and Whelgar's quests on the way. XP check (theory): ForeverDB shows open-world quests paying Classic XP (Young Crocolisk Skins 1,750 at 23; Cursed Crew 1,750; War Banners 2,300), and kill XP is at most Classic, so these quests reach about 27.3 and two grind blocks (about 98,000 XP) fill the gap to 30. With grinding at ~18,000 XP/h as the alternative, anything faster stays in: the Stockade (~30,000 XP for a 35–45 min run, wait up to 30 min for a group). Lifting the Curse → The Eye of Paleth (~4,850 XP) is left to leg 5, which does it at 31 while waiting for the Southshore boat, so the Halyndor trip costs no extra travel there. From the Ashes is taken with War Banners (Wowhead lists them side by side), so Nek'rosh's Gambit is finished mid-leg and the old end-of-leg hearth and walk back are gone.
legs.estTime: ≈12 h /played (estimate: Duskwood 2 h, Stormwind and the walk-in 0.6 h, Wetlands quests 4.1 h, grinding about 5.3 h). A Stockade run saves about 0.5–0.8 h net. Skeleton budget: 7.7 h.

(386, Stockade); Bazil Thredd (389, Stockade). Done: the Defias chain, Deadmines, and The Unsent Letter → Baros Alexston.
legs.end: Level 30.0, Wetlands, at the Excavation Site approach (path left of Thelgen Rock, 53.9, 65.4). Hearth: Menethil Harbor (ready; last used at the dig site). Trained 22 and 24 in Stormwind; level 26 can't be reached before Stormwind, so train 26/28/30 at the leg-5 Ironforge stop. Flight paths: Darkshire and Menethil added. Carrying the Excavation bundle: Lost in the Thicket Things (95647; Ardin gives Heartwoven 95809 inside) and Horrors in the Highland (95646); Changing Tastes (95697) is Horde-only. Also carrying: Death to the Dragonmaw (98291, elite targets), Carnage (98283, elite), A Friend of the Family (98190, for Bolvar in Stormwind), Understanding Our Present (98216) only if Uncovering the Past finished, and Forced Disarmament (98293) / Old Habits (98223) only if picked up. openQuestions: Quest supply vs level 30: with Classic quest XP (ForeverDB-observed for Forever open-world quests) and Classic kill XP, this leg's quests reach about 27.3 and the two grind blocks must supply about 98,000 XP (~530 kills, ~5.3 h). Moving the Excavation run to ~28 (the builder's idea) only moves its ~35,000 quest XP earlier: leg 5 already grinds 135,000 XP, so the grind just shifts. Real savings need extra quest XP above ~18,000 XP/h, e.g. the Duskwood 28–32 quests this route skips (the launch Gnome Warlock duo did Duskwood at 31.7–32.2, ~42,000 XP/h) or the leg-5 Wetlands group quests done with groups at 28–29. Judge decision.
Do the Valor ghosts (Lost Stalker → Ira's Dagger) need The Valor Family (96139) turned in first? We do it first to be safe; ForeverDB has no pick-up record for Ira's Dagger.

Howin Kindfeather's prerequisites are not published: Trying Times and Death to the Dragonmaw may need This Land Was Their Land; Razormaw Needling needs Crocs of the Sky → Crimson Crate Delivery (Wowhead series).

XP of the new quests (Ira's Dagger, The Valor Family, Return the Statuette 98189, From the Ashes, Crimson Crate Delivery, Razormaw Needling, Trying Times, Bloom of the Heavens) is unpublished; we assumed Classic-equivalent values for their level.

Strong Anti-Venom only cures poisons (Wowhead tooltip), but beta players reported the Excavation debuffs as diseases. The skeleton's reason for Alchemical Hazards may not hold; bring a priest, paladin or shaman.
Skeleton end state lists Changing Tastes (95697), but it is Horde-only (Borstan, Orgrimmar). Heartwoven (95809) is handed out inside the dungeon by Ardin, not before.

Death to the Dragonmaw's targets and Carnage are level 29–30 elites (Wowhead), and Forced Disarmament starts from armament piles inside elite-filled Dragonmaw Retreat. Leg 5's 'finish the Wetlands' step should treat them as group quests or skips.

legs.title: Excavation Site, Southshore, City of Dalaran & Arathi
legs.summary: Run the Excavation Site once at 30 with its quests, then sweep the northern Wetlands (Dragonmaw Retreat, Carnage, Dun Modr, the Thandol Span and the new Corma chain), clear Lifting the Curse and take the new ship from Menethil to Southshore. Do Farren’s coast chain, fly to Ironforge to train, hand in the Prism and take the Gnomeregan quests, collect the Dalaran quests (and Shoni’s Gnomeregan quest) in Stormwind, run Gnomeregan, hearth back, clear Alterac on the way to one City of Dalaran run, and finish in Arathi at Refuge Pointe.
legs.why: The order follows the launch Alliance trail (Hillsbrad at 32, Alterac at 33, Arathi at 34; race.aotc.gg) and the judged skeleton. Excavation and City of Dalaran are done once, with every Alliance quest in the log, because their quests are the reward: Excavation pays 4,900 + 6,150 + 1,250 + 6,150 XP and each Alliance Dalaran quest 9,400 (warcraft.wiki.gg, matching the beta table's ~37,600 total). The northern Wetlands block is one loop: the Dun Modr camp holds three chains (Thandol Span, Bring Back a Bang, Corma) a few hundred yards apart. Farren's coast chain is done before the city stop so Reassignment (3,200) is handed in at Stormwind Keep on the same visit as the Dalaran pickups. The Stormwind Wizard's Sanctum also gives Malin's Request, the breadcrumb that unlocks Worth Its Weight in Gold at Refuge Pointe. Alterac is crossed east to west so the lions, the Syndicate camp and the ogres all lie on the way to Dalaran's gate. Gnomeregan is run at the Ironforge stop and Lifting the Curse while the ship is away because both pay more per hour than the troll grind this leg would otherwise end with (beta table: ~46,000 Alliance quest XP for Gnomeregan). Biggest caveat: by Classic XP values these zones, even with both, only carry you to about 33.7, so the skeleton’s 35.3 needs a ~5–6 h grind (see open questions).
legs.estTime: About 9 h /played of questing and dungeons to ~33.7 (the original 6.5 h, plus ~0.25 h for Lifting the Curse and 2–2.5 h for Gnomeregan), then 5–6 h of grinding to 35.3 (estimate). Without a Gnomeregan group: ~6.75 h plus 7–8 h of grinding.
legs.start: Level 30.0, Wetlands, at the Excavation Site approach (path left of Thelgen Rock, 53.9, 65.4). Hearth: Menethil Harbor (ready; last used at ~26.7 in leg 4). Trained 22/24 (Stormwind); 26/28/30 are trained at this leg’s Ironforge stop. Flight paths add Darkshire and Menethil. Carrying: Lost in the Thicket Things (95647), Horrors in the Highland (95646); Death to the Dragonmaw (98291), Carnage (98283), Forced Disarmament (98293) if started; Nek’rosh’s Gambit (465) if leg 4 did not finish it; Understanding Our Present (98216) if Uncovering the Past went fast; A Friend of the Family (98190) for Bolvar. The Cursed Crew (289) turned in, which opens Lifting the Curse. Stockade done or skipped.
legs.end: Level 35.3, Refuge Pointe (Arathi Highlands); flight path learned. Hearth: Southshore. Trained 26/28/30 and 32 (Ironforge). Talents: drain-tank Affliction (Siphon Life at 30). Flight paths add Southshore and Refuge Pointe. Carrying: Power Overwhelming (92489) and A Green Sample (92456), both complete, for Stormwind; Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators (2928, complete) for Shoni in Stormwind; A Fine Mess (2904) for Scooty in Booty Bay if Kernobee was escorted; Letter to Stormpike (514) for Ironforge; a Hints of a New Plague? step if mid-chain. Done: Excavation Site; Gnomeregan; City of Dalaran (An Alarming Request, Heart of Disruption, and Starving Arcane only if one run finished it); Prehistoric Prism turned in; For Further Study only if the Goaz chain was done in a group.

openQuestions: XP gap (biggest issue): by Classic quest XP (QuestieDB xpDB; ForeverDB shows Classic quests still pay Classic amounts) and Forever dungeon values (warcraft.wiki.gg), this leg’s content reaches only about 33.7 at Witherbark, even after the verifier added Gnomeregan (~28k in-leg quest XP assumed, beta table total ~46k) and Lifting the Curse, and assuming Starving Arcane does not finish in one run. 35.3 then needs ~97k XP (~400 kills, 5–6 h). Moving Stranglethorn earlier does not remove this grind: leg 6’s quests are full-XP at 33.7 and at 35.3 alike, so the same grind just moves to leg 6. Only more content removes it: e.g. Kopp’s Shimmering Flats/Desolace 32–35 loop, the Duskwood 30–32 return that launch Alliance players used, or the Wetlands elite group quests (Goaz chain, Stopping the Cycle, Defeat Nek’rosh) with a group. The skeleton’s 33k XP/h × 8.8 h does not fit what these zones hold; launch Alliance at 31–34 made 25–32k XP/h.

Elites: Wowhead's Forever data marks Dragonmaw Retreat (Reclaimer, Soulbinder, Infiltrator 29–30), Carnage (30), the Direforge Hill and Dun Modr Dark Irons (27–31) and the Goaz golems (32) as elite. The skeleton treated Death to the Dragonmaw and Bring Back a Bang as solo quests. Launch players returned to the Dragonmaw chain at ~33 (race.aotc.gg), which fits elites. Confirm in game; if they are elite, group at Howin's camp or drop Death to the Dragonmaw. The leg now tells the player to keep the Excavation group for the Dragonmaw, Carnage and Direforge elites.

City of Dalaran has 4 Alliance dungeon quests (Heart of Disruption, Starving Arcane, Power Overwhelming, A Green Sample; 9,400 XP each) plus An Alarming Request (660) and Friend of the Kirin Tor (270). The skeleton's "8 quests" counted both factions: Blood in the Streets, Shrewd Negotiations and Opportunistic Education are Horde (warcraft.wiki.gg). ConquestCapped's 3,950 per quest is outdated.

Training: leg 4 trained only 22/24 in Stormwind (its end says 26/28/30 wait for this leg), so the old start line ("Trained 24/26") was wrong; this leg now trains 26/28/30 at the Ironforge stop (~31.8) and 32 after the Gnomeregan turn-ins (~32.5). Our talent order (class-gnome-warlock.json) is all Affliction from 10, so the "drain-tank respec" is a check, not a reset; Zalidan’s video also says no trainer respec is needed.
Changing Tastes (95697) is a Horde quest (Borstan, Orgrimmar), so leg 4's end state should not list it. Heartwoven's XP is not logged anywhere; this leg assumes ~2,500.

Essene (Hearts of the Lost → Accessories of the Lost → Sentiments of the Lost) has no recorded position or item locations. Corma Villard is at the Wetlands end of the Thandol Span (Wowhead 49.2–50.6, 11.4–12.6), so the chain is placed with the Thandol Span quests at ~30.5; XP is assumed (level 33: 1,650 + 3,300 + 1,650).

Bring Back a Bang: giver Ashlan Stonesmirk (Dun Modr camp, 50.0, 18.2, ForeverDB Nov 5); the turn-in NPC and XP are not logged. The leg assumes Ashlan and 3,250 XP. ForeverDB players logged the Stolen Explosives at Wetlands 61.2, 26.0 (Direforge Hill), which matches the leg.

Boat: a Southshore–Menethil boat existed in the beta (forum thread "Remove the Stormwind-Auberdine and the Southshore-Menethil boats", Oct 19, 141 posts) and ForeverDB names the launch route Menethil Harbor → Southshore → Auberdine, with no timings. A walking alternative avoids the boat: cross the Thandol Span to Refuge Pointe (learn it at ~31, hand in Plea to the Alliance, do Northfold Manor at its own level) and walk west over Thoradin’s Wall to Southshore. Travel time is about the same; it also makes the later Southshore → Refuge Pointe trip a flight.

Dalaran: Warcraft Tavern puts Archmage Celindra (Friend of the Kirin Tor) in the Violet Citadel at 14.2, 60.1 "inside Dalaran"; whether the city is reachable right after the run is unconfirmed. Warcraft Tavern also says one run rarely yields 8 of each Starving Arcane remnant, so the levels after the run assume only Heart of Disruption pays (+9,400 / +0.16 level if Starving Arcane does finish).

The Shamed Lieutenant (98219) starts with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind and ends at Farren. Unknown whether Farren offers Down the Coast without it (Classic: yes). If he does not, do the coast chain after the city stop instead and hand Reassignment in at leg 6's Stormwind visit.

Coordinates: Stormwind uses the harbor-era Forever map (Questie's converted data; Wowhead lists only Classic spots for Major Samuelson and Archmage Malin). The Southshore and Menethil boat piers have no logged coordinates.

Gnomeregan (added by the verifier): the beta table gives ~46,460 Alliance quest XP in total but no per-quest split; this leg assumes ~28k at the Tinker Town turn-ins, with Gyrodrillmatic (Shoni, Stormwind) and A Fine Mess (Scooty, Booty Bay) paid in leg 6. Run time ~1.5–2 h (skeleton-B estimate). It is only ~20–40% better than the troll grind it replaces, so skip it if no group forms quickly.

Hillsbrad’s Hoard (98059) and Brewer’s Trade (98071) are level-27 Forever quests in Hillsbrad (a delivery to the Hillsbrad town hall; bottles to Dun Garok) with no giver, faction or XP logged on Wowhead or ForeverDB. If Southshore offers them at 31, they are full-XP deliveries worth checking in game.

Leg-6 hand-off: resolved. Leg 6's start now matches this leg's end, and its stops hand in Letter to Stormpike (l06-004), Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators (l06-007) and A Fine Mess (l06-031). Lifting the Curse is done only here (l05-025 to l05-027); leg 4 no longer does it.

legs.title: Stranglethorn Vale & the Felsteed
legs.summary: Train in Ironforge and hand in leg 5's Ironforge and Stormwind quests (Stormpike's letter, Shoni's Gnomeregan parts, the two City of Dalaran quests), then walk into Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Do the north on the way in, then two loops out of Booty Bay (west coast and north; middle and east), then the quests on Booty Bay's doorstep. Train 36/38 in Stormwind at 38, grind to 40, and sail to Ratchet for the Felsteed before flying to Thelsamar.
legs.why: Stranglethorn is where launch racers levelled at 35–38 (the leader: Stranglethorn 35.6–36.0 and 37.8–38.3, then Swamp of Sorrows; nobody in Riverglades; race.aotc.gg). The north (Rebel Camp, Nesingwary, the Kurzen cave) is done on the way in from Duskwood because you can't fly to Booty Bay before discovering it. Each later loop starts from Booty Bay and ends with a hearth, so the zone's 8-minute length is walked as few times as possible. New Forever quests are folded into those loops: The Cook in the Cage is in the cave you clear for Special Forces, the Zul'Kunda trio sits next to the Bloodscalp ears, and Knaz's drums share the lake with Hostile Takeover. XP check (theory: Classic quest XP from classicdb, Forever values where logged, Classic kill XP): with leg 5's hand-ins (9,400 each for the two Dalaran quests per warcraft.wiki.gg and ForeverDB; 4,400 for Gyrodrillmatic per ForeverDB) the quests and their kills reach about 37.7 before the last turn-ins, so roughly 188,000 XP (≈690 kills, ≈4.8 h) of grinding fills 37.7→40.1. That is why the skeleton's early-switch rule is shown as a decision at the Stormwind training stop. The Felsteed spell lists no riding requirement (Wowhead Forever), and Booty Bay is your hearth, so the return boat from Ratchet is skipped.
legs.estTime: ≈11.5–12.5 h /played (our estimate: ~7 h of questing, travel and the short grind to 38; ~4.3 h of grinding from 38 to 40, which also finishes Up to Snuff and Keep An Eye Out; ~0.5 h for the Felsteed trip and flights). Skeleton budget: 10.2 h.
legs.start: Level 35.3, Refuge Pointe (Arathi Highlands); flight path learned. Hearth: Southshore. Trained 26/28/30 and 32 (Ironforge). Talents: drain-tank Affliction (Siphon Life at 30). Flight paths add Southshore and Refuge Pointe. Carrying: Power Overwhelming (92489) and A Green Sample (92456), both complete, for Stormwind; Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators (2928, complete) for Shoni in Stormwind; A Fine Mess (2904) for Scooty in Booty Bay if Kernobee was escorted; Letter to Stormpike (514) for Ironforge; a Hints of a New Plague? step if mid-chain. Done: Excavation Site; Gnomeregan; City of Dalaran (An Alarming Request, Heart of Disruption, and Starving Arcane only if one run finished it); Prehistoric Prism turned in; For Further Study only if the Goaz chain was done in a group.
legs.end: Level 40.1, Thelsamar (Loch Modan). Hearth: Thelsamar (re-bound). Trained 34 (Ironforge), 36/38 (Stormwind) and 40 (Ironforge). Felsteed learned (fallback: Apprentice Riding at Steelgrill's Depot). Flight paths add Booty Bay and Ratchet. Carrying: Ironband Wants You! (707) from Prospector Stormpike, for Prospector Ironband at leg 7's first stop (it unlocks Find Agmond).

openQuestions: XP shortfall: on Classic quest XP (classicdb), Forever values where logged (Dalaran 9,400 each, Gyrodrillmatic 4,400) and Classic kill XP, every quest on this route plus its kills reaches only ~37.7 before the final turn-ins, leaving ~188,000 XP (~690 kills, ~4.8 h) of grinding, ~165,000 of it from 38 to 40. That triggers the skeleton's early-switch rule. The default still grinds because Riverglades has no quest data. Verifier check of the alternatives: Kopp's Faldir's Cove chain (Arathi, req 35, ~19k quest XP, last turn-in at Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay) and the Swamp of Sorrows hub the leader used at 38.9 (6 Classic Alliance quests ~17k XP plus 4 new Forever ones with unknown XP) are roughly level with the ~36k XP/h this grind model assumes, so neither is a clear win on current data.

New Forever quests: start points are not published for Anything of Value (zeppelin wreck near Zul'Kunda), Where's the Key? (Zimmix's cage), The Cook in the Cage (assumed Wendel Mathers, 44.2, 8.0) and Talk of the Town (giver unknown). Turn-in for Anything of Value is only "someone in Booty Bay". XP for all of them is guessed at Classic rates for their DB levels.

Where the Compound Cage Key, Kurzen Fighter's Uniform, Primitive Key and Drums of Crude Oil come from in Forever is not published (SoD: key from Kurzen Elites/Subchiefs, uniform from a crate at 49.6, 7.7).

Special Forces is listed as a skeleton skip, but Kopp does it at 35–36 and its mobs block the cave you clear for The Cook in the Cage and the Bookie Herod strongbox, so this leg takes it (+2,850 XP plus 16 kills for about 2 minutes of extra walking).

The Cook in the Cage may be rogue-only: in Season of Discovery the same cage, key and uniform (items 216616/216617) were a rogue rune, and Wendel's gossip says to "filch" the key from the Kurzen higher-ups (pick-pocket). If a warlock is not offered the quest, skip it and Returning to Port (≈3,850 XP by our guess).

Felsteed: does Strahad teach it without the 100 g Apprentice Riding in Forever? Players in a launch-day thread say class mounts are still free (forum t/2400779), but they argue from Classic and nobody had reached 40 yet; Blizzard has not confirmed it.
Is the 36/38 training trip worth ~12 minutes? It is kept because Drain Life and Curse of Agony ranks at 38 speed up the ~5 h grind; training everything at 40 instead would save the trip.
Boat timing Booty Bay → Ratchet and flight time Booty Bay → Stormwind are not measured in Forever yet.

Required level of The Cook in the Cage is unknown (DB quest level 38). If it can't be accepted at ~35.8, take it on the way past at the end of pass 2 instead and finish it with the optional Bookie Herod loop.

Hand-offs: resolved by the route critic. Leg 7's start now lists Ironband Wants You! (707), and its step l07-003 hands it in. A Fine Mess (Scooty) has no logged Forever XP, so it is left out of the level estimates.

legs.title: Badlands, Riverglades, Krol'dok & Uldaman
legs.summary: Ride from Thelsamar into the Badlands and do its level-35–43 quests in one loop while they still pay full XP, picking up four Uldaman starters on the way. Walk into Riverglades, the new zone, make Farholde Keep your flight path and inn, and quest it from the lowest-level areas outward, with a bail-out to the Swamp of Sorrows if it pays badly. Finish with one Uldaman run carrying every quest, then hand everything in at Thelsamar and Ironforge.
legs.why: The Badlands quests are level 35–43 (Wowhead Forever DB, unchanged from Classic) and pay full XP at 40, but would be 20–60% grey at 45 (Classic rule, warcraft.wiki.gg); the same loop collects Uldaman's starters (A Sign of Hope, Power Stones, Solution to Doom, Find Agmond → Agmond's Fate if Ironband offers it, Badlands Reagent Run → Uldaman Reagent Run). Riverglades is level 36–44 (Wowhead zone 16591) with 150–200 quests (Blizzard), it borders the Badlands, and its Farholde Keep flight path links straight back to Thelsamar (launch-client datamine), so it replaces Kopp's Desolace and Stranglethorn legs, which each need a boat or a long flight. Its loop order here follows mob levels in the Wowhead DB (36–39 around Farholde and Meadowsbrook, 37–40 in the west and centre, 41–45 on the pirate coast and at Bolder'ok), because no Riverglades quest is in any database. Uldaman is the best 40s dungeon for Alliance quest XP (~60k in a beta table, ~52k by Classic values here) and its turn-ins sit in Thelsamar, the Badlands and Ironforge, all on this leg's path. Training 42/44 is folded into the Ironforge pickup stop because Riverglades has no warlock trainer. XP check: by Classic values the Badlands loop reaches only ~40.65, not the skeleton's 41.3; entering Riverglades at 40.65 costs nothing, since its quests start at 36.
legs.estTime: About 14–15 h /played (estimate: Badlands 1.8 h; Riverglades 40.65→44.4 ≈ 8.3 h at a theoretical 45k XP/h; Krol'dok or more Riverglades 1 h; Uldaman block with travel and group forming 3–3.5 h). The skeleton budgeted 12.4 h.
legs.start: Level 40.1, Thelsamar (Loch Modan). Hearth: Thelsamar (re-bound). Trained 34 (Ironforge), 36/38 (Stormwind) and 40 (Ironforge). legs.end: Level 45.3, Ironforge, after the Uldaman turn-ins and the Vault voucher. Hearth: Thelsamar. Trained 42/44 (Ironforge). Flight paths add Farholde Keep. Nothing carried that must be turned in; Portents of Uldum is now offered by High Explorer Magellas (leg 8).

openQuestions: Hand-off to leg 6: resolved. Leg 6 now takes Ironband Wants You! (707) from Prospector Stormpike at l06-004, so step l07-003 hands it in at 40.1 and Find Agmond → Murdaloc → Agmond's Fate stay in the Badlands loop whichever pre-quest rule Forever uses (QuestieDB: 707 required; classicdb and warcraft.wiki.gg: previous quest only). The Badlands → Riverglades pass is unconfirmed in the live game. Beta map comparisons show a pass in the south Badlands running along Redridge's east edge; warcraft.wiki.gg says "north of Twilight's Shroud"; games.gg says no Badlands entrance was confirmed. No coordinates anywhere.

Riverglades has no quest data (Wowhead, QuestieDB, guides) as of Nov 5. Every Riverglades loop and XP figure here is inferred from mob levels and friendly NPCs in the Wowhead NPC database (ids 255769–259766 scanned). Re-check daily and replace these steps with real quests.
Krol'dok Stronghold has no published quests; only two datamined Krol'dok Moulding items that start quests. The ≥3-quest rule will most likely skip it.

XP shortfall in the Badlands: by Classic values (classicdb) the Badlands quests plus ~95 quest kills reach ~40.65, not 41.3. Kopp's 41.25 also used Tremors part 2, the auction-house item quests, This Is Going to Be Hard and a 30-minute whelp grind.

Uldaman XP in Forever: Oct 1 notes cut dungeon quests' extra XP by 50%; the two beta tables disagree by about 2×. This leg counts ~52k quest XP by Classic values plus ~7k group mob XP, which needs arrival at ~44.8 to end at 45.3.
BlizzardPapi's beta video lists Farholde Keep at 64, 23, which conflicts with the Wowhead flight master (60.6, 81.4) and innkeeper (64.6, 84.2). This leg uses Wowhead.
Is Bolder'ok (Horde-friendly ogres) hostile to Alliance, and are Rog'mar's level-55 guards a problem on PvP realms? Unknown.
Total time is ~14–15 h against the skeleton's 12.4 h, mainly because Riverglades is costed at 45k XP/h from 40.65 to 44.4 and the Badlands gives less than planned.

Faster if leg 6 changes: if leg 6’s Ironforge stop also takes The Lost Dwarves (2398, needs 35) and Reclaimed Treasures (1360, needs 33), steps l07-054 to l07-057 (the pre-Uldaman Ironforge round trip) can go, and 42/44 is trained at the end of this leg (about 8–10 min saved; costs two more quest-log slots in Riverglades).

Indurium (1108, 3,000 XP): like Find Agmond, its breadcrumb (Martek the Exiled, from the Shimmering Flats) is shown only as the previous quest in the series. Step l07-010 asks Martek; if he offers it, the flakes drop from the same Stonevault troggs as Murdaloc.

legs.title: The Hinterlands & Tanaris
legs.summary: Fly to Southshore and ride into the Hinterlands. Do its four Alliance quests, then grind trolls, owlbeasts and wolves to 48 out of Aerie Peak. Train 46/48 in Ironforge, fly to Farholde Keep, and take the new Powderfuse Port ship to Tanaris. Clear Gadgetzan's quests in two loops, then grind Thistleshrub Valley to 50.
legs.why: Neither zone has new Forever quests in the Wowhead DB, so this is Classic content (Wowhead Forever DB sweep; games.gg: "nothing announced for Forever rewrites this zone's hubs"). The route already skips Feralas, Darnassus, Booty Bay and the Blasted Lands. That cuts most Hinterlands chains: Food for Baby, Favored of Elune?, Rhapsody, Sharpbeak and Sprinkle's mushroom all start or end there. What is left is Witherbark Cages → The Altar of Zul, Skulk Rock Clean-up and Troll Necklace Bounty: about 16,600 quest XP (classicdb). On Classic quest XP and the Classic kill formula, reaching 48 needs about 305,000 XP of grinding there. The grind is split at 47 with a stop at Aerie Peak to test whether the repeatable Troll Necklace Bounty pays XP (Classic data: 3,900 per 5 necklaces). If it does, troll kills are worth about 1.5× an owlbeast kill. Kopp's own 46–47 block is mostly the same grind ("trolls and wolves around Zul"). We grind to 48 rather than 47.5, so one Ironforge stop trains both 46 and 48 and leg 9 starts as planned. Tanaris is denser: about 61,000 quest XP plus about 40,000 kill XP from three loops. The east loop (Wastewander, Lost Rigger Cove) ends at Steamwheedle Port. The south loop (Dunemaul, Uldum, Thistleshrub Valley, Noxious Lair) is a circle ending in a hearth. That reaches about 48.75, and Thistleshrub Valley (mobs 47–50) fills the rest. Zul'Farrak fails the skeleton's ≥4-quest rule: only Troll Temper and Divino-matic Rod are reachable. The Powderfuse → Steamwheedle ship is the only way into Kalimdor that needs no undiscovered flight path (official; foreverdb).
legs.estTime: ≈19–24 h /played (our estimate: ~4.5 h of quests and travel plus ~15–19 h of grinding at 25–35k XP/h). The skeleton budget of 14.4 h assumed 42k XP/h, which this leg cannot reach without more quests. If the necklace repeatable pays XP in Forever, the Hinterlands grind is roughly 3 h shorter.
legs.start: Level 45.3, Ironforge, after the Uldaman turn-ins. Hearth: Thelsamar. Trained 42/44 (Ironforge). Flight paths add Farholde Keep. Nothing carried that must be turned in (Portents of Uldum is offered here because leg 7 handed the Platinum Discs voucher to the Vault at l07-079).
legs.end: Level 50.0, Gadgetzan (Tanaris). Hearth: Gadgetzan. Trained 46/48 (Ironforge). Flight paths add Aerie Peak and Gadgetzan. Carrying: Return to Ironforge (2977) for Historian Karnik on the leg 9 Ironforge stop; optionally Yuka Screwspigot (4324) for leg 10. No Un'Goro breadcrumb exists in Gadgetzan (Classic data), and The Super Snapper FX is not open (it needs The Borrower from Rut'theran). Zul'Farrak skipped.

steps.text: Hall of Explorers: accept **Portents of Uldum** from High Explorer Magellas
steps.note: Leg 7 ends with the Platinum Discs voucher handed in at the Vault (l07-079), which opens this quest. If Magellas has nothing, skip this step, the next one and the Uldum step.

steps.text: Turn in **Portents of Uldum** to Historian Karnik; accept **Seeing What Happens**
steps.note: Seeing What Happens needs level 45 and is handed in at the gates of Uldum in Tanaris (4,700 XP, then 4,700 more for The Stone Watcher).

steps.text: Buy cooked food at the Auction House for the Well Fed buff
steps.note: Most cooked food gives +5% kill XP for about 15 minutes in Forever. This leg is mostly grinding, so keep a stack and eat before each grind block.

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden to **Southshore**
steps.note: You cannot fly to Aerie Peak until you have found its flight path. The reverse flight measured 3:26.

steps.text: Ride east out of Southshore, past Durnholde Keep, to the Hinterlands path
steps.note: Kopp's path into the Hinterlands, marked by two gryphons. Stay off the north road to Tarren Mill, a Horde town.

steps.text: Ride up to Aerie Peak and learn the flight path from Guthrum Thunderfist
steps.note: Aerie Peak links to Ironforge, Southshore, Refuge Pointe, Chillwind Camp and Light's Hope.

steps.text: Aviary cave: accept **Witherbark Cages** from Gryphon Master Talonaxe
steps.note: Ignore Falstad and Agnar: their chains start in Stormwind and Feralas, which this route never visits.

steps.text: Accept **Skulk Rock Clean-up** and **Troll Necklace Bounty** from Fraggar Thundermantle
Make Aerie Peak your home at Innkeeper Thulfram
steps.note: You hearth back here twice in this zone. Log out in this inn between sessions so the long grind starts rested.

steps.text: Zun'watha: check the first and second cages
steps.note: These trolls are 40–42 and worth little XP: kill only the ones in your way.

steps.text: Hiri'watha: check the third cage
Skulk Rock: kill 10 **Green Sludges** and 10 **Jade Oozes**
steps.note: Oozes have no ranged attacks and never flee, so they are easy drain-tank targets.

steps.text: If an **OOX-09/HL Distress Beacon** dropped, take it to the robot at the river head north-east of Skulk Rock
steps.note: 4,400 XP for a random drop. Skip the escort: its reward is handed in at Booty Bay, which this route never visits.

steps.text: Hearth to Aerie Peak
steps.note: Your last hearth was at l07-073 (Thelsamar). If it is still on cooldown, ride back west to Aerie Peak instead.

steps.text: Turn in **Witherbark Cages**; accept **The Altar of Zul**
Turn in **Skulk Rock Clean-up** to Fraggar Thundermantle
Ride south-east to the Altar of Zul
steps.note: About 4 minutes mounted. Grind anything level 45+ that blocks the road.

steps.text: Climb to the top of the **Altar of Zul**, then come straight back down

mobs.name: Qiaga the Keeper
mobs.note: elite; wait until she walks away

steps.note: Qiaga the Keeper is a level 50 elite who walks the top. Go up behind her; if she aggroes, Fear her and run.

steps.text: Before each grind block: eat Well Fed food; when you stop playing, hearth and log out in the inn
steps.note: Rested XP doubles kill XP and builds 5% of a level per 8 hours in an inn. On a 10-hour grind, every logout counts.

steps.text: Grind **Vilebranch trolls** around the Altar of Zul until 47.0; keep every **Troll Tribal Necklace**

mobs.name: Witherbark Sadist
mobs.note: overflow spot at Shadra'Alor if the Altar is crowded; also drops necklaces

steps.note: Kopp's 46–47 spot; necklaces drop from about 1 troll in 5 (classicdb). Stay out of Shaol'watha and Jintha'Alor to the east: those trolls are elite.

steps.text: Level 47: hearth to Aerie Peak (a good place to stop a session in the inn)
steps.note: Splitting the grind here costs one extra 4-minute ride back east, and it tells you whether the necklace repeatable pays XP.

steps.text: Turn in **The Altar of Zul** to Gryphon Master Talonaxe
steps.note: Decline Thadius Grimshade: it sends you to the Blasted Lands and then into Zul'Farrak.

steps.text: Turn in **Troll Necklace Bounty**; hand every extra 5 necklaces to the repeatable version
steps.note: Watch the XP bar on the first repeatable hand-in. Classic data lists 3,900 XP each and Wowhead Forever shows an XP value for it, but nobody has confirmed it in Forever since the pre-launch repeatable-XP fix.

steps.text: Ride back east and grind to 48: trolls if the repeatable paid XP, otherwise owlbeasts and wolves
steps.note: If it paid, stay on the Altar of Zul trolls and count 3,900 XP per 5 necklaces toward 48. If not, grind Savage Owlbeasts (46–47) and Silvermane Stalkers (47–48, stealthed) east of Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
quests.note: only if the repeatable paid XP

steps.text: Hearth to Aerie Peak
Level 48: hand any remaining necklace sets to Fraggar, then leave the Hinterlands

quests.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
quests.note: repeatable; only if it pays XP

steps.note: The skeleton planned 47.5. Grinding to 48 lets one Ironforge stop train both 46 and 48 (Soul Fire).

steps.text: Fly from Guthrum Thunderfist to **Ironforge**
Forlorn Cavern: train your level 46 and 48 spells
steps.note: Level 48 adds Soul Fire. There is no Alliance warlock trainer on Kalimdor, so do not skip this stop.

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden to **Farholde Keep** (via Thelsamar)
steps.note: Farholde links only to Thelsamar, Lakeshire and Morgan's Vigil. Powderfuse Port has a flight master but no routes.

steps.text: Ride north-east from Farholde Keep to **Powderfuse Port** on the east coast
steps.note: Port is around 77.6, 50.8. Nobody has timed this ride; on the map it looks like 3–5 minutes mounted.

steps.text: Take the ship from Powderfuse Port to **Steamwheedle Port** (Tanaris)
steps.note: Plan 5–10 minutes with the wait. If no ship comes, look for a temporary portal on the dock.

steps.text: Steamwheedle Port: accept **Southsea Shakedown** and **Pirate Hats Ahoy!**
steps.note: Skip Stoley (needs a Booty Bay breadcrumb) and Yeh'kinya (needs Feralas).

steps.text: Optional: accept **Yuka Screwspigot** from Yorba Screwspigot and carry it to the Burning Steppes
steps.note: Needs level 48. A free 2,650 XP if leg 10 passes Yuka at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

steps.text: Ride west to Gadgetzan
steps.note: About 2 minutes. The road crosses the Wastewander camps: you come back for them in a moment.

steps.text: Learn the Gadgetzan flight path from Bera Stonehammer
steps.note: Gadgetzan links to Marshal's Refuge, Cenarion Hold, Thalanaar and Theramore.

steps.text: Make Gadgetzan your home at Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
Accept **Wastewander Justice**, **Water Pouch Bounty** and both **WANTED** posters
Accept **The Thirsty Goblin**, **The Dunemaul Compound**, **Thistleshrub Valley** and **Gadgetzan Water Survey**
steps.note: Thistleshrub Valley needs level 45; Tran'rek offers it without his Booty Bay breadcrumb in Classic data.

steps.text: East of town: kill 10 **Wastewander Bandits** and 10 **Thieves**; loot 5 **Water Pouches**
steps.note: Any Wastewander drops pouches; finish them in the next camp if short.

steps.text: Gadgetzan: turn in **Wastewander Justice**; accept **More Wastewander Justice**
South-east camps: kill **Shadow Mages**, **Rogues**, **Assassins** and **Caliph Scorpidsting**
steps.note: Needs 10 mages, 8 rogues and 6 assassins. Caliph walks between the tents with two stealthed guards.

steps.text: Ride east to the cave at 68, 41 and through it into Lost Rigger Cove
Lost Rigger Cove: kill 10 of each **Southsea** pirate type; collect 20 **Pirate Hats**

quests.name: Ship Schedules
quests.note: only if a Ship Schedule drops

items.name: Ship Schedule
items.note: random drop: starts Ship Schedules (4,850 XP), handed in at Steamwheedle Port

steps.note: 40 kills in all; the hats drop along the way. If a Ship Schedule drops, take its quest too.

steps.text: Kill **Andre Firebeard** in the two-storey house and take his head
Ride north to Steamwheedle Port: turn in **Southsea Shakedown**, **Andre Firebeard** and **Pirate Hats Ahoy!**
Hearth to Gadgetzan
steps.note: Riding back takes about 2 minutes if the hearth is still on cooldown.

steps.text: Turn in **More Wastewander Justice**, **Caliph Scorpidsting** and **Water Pouch Bounty**

steps.note: Two hostile insects (47–48) spawn once you have the sample: kill them or ride away. Guides put the pool at 39, 29–30.

steps.text: Gadgetzan: turn in **Gadgetzan Water Survey**; accept **Noxious Lair Investigation**
Ride south to Marvon Rivetseeker: accept **Gahz'ridian** and wear the detector helm
steps.note: The helm shows the buried ornaments on your minimap. Pick them up all through the southern loop.

steps.text: Dunemaul Compound: kill **Gor'marok the Ravager**, plus Brutes and Enforcers
steps.note: Needs 10 Brutes, 10 Enforcers and Gor'marok. Clear a path to him first; finish the counts in the southern camp.

steps.text: Southern ogre camps: finish the Brutes and Enforcers; keep digging up **Gahz'ridian Ornaments**
steps.note: Ornament spots per ForeverDB: 47.8, 66.2 and 38.9, 65.9 and 39.7, 74.5. You need 30.

steps.note: Talk the Stone Watcher through, use the pedestal again, then take Return to Ironforge for leg 9. Approach up the west side.

steps.note: Wowhead's Classic and Forever tooltips both list 30 Punctured and 30 Empty Dew Glands, so that is old data clutter. One Laden Dew Gland (from Dew Collectors) completes it.
