steps.note: 5,900 XP but a 30-minute timer (classicdb). He follows you; take him to Torta at Steamwheedle Port and never let him fall behind.

steps.text: Noxious Lair: kill **Centipaar** until you have 5 **Insect Parts**
steps.note: Stay on the outer mounds; the bugs inside the hive come in packs.

steps.text: Hearth to Gadgetzan (if Tooga is following you, travel with him instead)
steps.note: Hearthing leaves Tooga behind and fails his quest.

steps.text: Turn in **Thistleshrub Valley**, **The Dunemaul Compound** and **The Thirsty Goblin**; accept **In Good Taste**
Turn in **In Good Taste** (Sprinkle) and **Noxious Lair Investigation** (Pestlezugg)
steps.note: Decline Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient (its mushroom is in the Hinterlands). Fizzledowser then offers The Scrimshank Redemption: skip it (a long cave trip).

steps.text: Optional: lead Tooga to Torta at Steamwheedle Port
Decision: skip Zul'Farrak — at most 3 of its quests are on this route
steps.note: The skeleton rule needs 4. Troll Temper and Divino-matic Rod are here, and Scarab Shells may be too; Gahz'rilla starts in the Shimmering Flats and needs the Mallet of Zul'Farrak.

steps.text: Ride south to Marvon Rivetseeker: turn in **Gahz'ridian**
steps.note: Short on ornaments? Keep the helm on during the next grind and come back.

steps.text: If an **OOX-17/TN Distress Beacon** dropped, ride south-east to the crashed robot
steps.note: 4,400 XP for about 2 extra minutes on the way to Thistleshrub Valley. Skip the escort: it is handed in at Booty Bay.

steps.text: Grind **Thistleshrubs** in Thistleshrub Valley until 49.5
steps.note: The highest normal mobs near Gadgetzan, so the best XP per kill at 49. No loot worth selling.

steps.text: Grind **Searing Rocs** and **Glasshide Petrifiers** on the valley's north rim until 50
steps.note: Use this when the valley is crowded. Otherwise stay on the Thistleshrubs.

steps.text: Hearth to Gadgetzan
Level 50 in Gadgetzan: leg 9 starts with the ride south into Un'Goro

That is ~305k in the Hinterlands (45.5→48) and ~175k in Tanaris (48.75→50), or ~15–19 h at 25–35k XP/h. The skeleton's 14.4 h is not reachable. Options for the judge: (a) put Kopp's Blasted Lands set at 49–50 back in (five collection quests at 4,700 XP each, plus Nethergarde turn-ins, done while grinding); (b) bring back a Feralas pass from Gadgetzan (about 60–80k quest XP at 43–48, but it needs the Thalanaar and Feathermoon flight paths); (c) accept the grind.

Grind rate in Forever above 40 is unknown. Blizzard raised creature health at higher levels on Nov 2 (https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2360696/9), and the Voidwalker's health was cut. Nobody on race.aotc.gg was above 39.2 on Nov 5.
Farholde Keep → Powderfuse Port ride time, and where the ship docks at both ports. Our only anchors are Farholde (60.6, 81.4) and Melbin Powderfuse (77.6, 50.8), so the 3–5 min ride is a guess.

Hinterlands and Tanaris may have new Forever quests that are not in the Wowhead DB yet. The Nov 5 scan of Forever quest ids 90500–100500 has no quest naming a place in either zone, but its non-battleground quests with known levels stop at 42. Take any new quest offered at Aerie Peak or Gadgetzan if its objectives lie on these loops.

Resolved: Wowhead's Classic tooltip for The Thirsty Goblin shows the same 30 Punctured / 30 Empty Dew Gland lines, so they are old data and one Laden Dew Gland completes it (https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=2605).

Biggest lever in this leg: does the repeatable Troll Necklace Bounty (2881) pay XP in Forever? classicdb lists 3,900 XP per hand-in, Kopp turns in extra sets while leveling, and Wowhead Forever shows an XP calculator for 2881 as it does for 2880 (none for a zero-XP quest such as Noggenfogger Elixir). Blizzard patched a repeatable-XP exploit (Applejack Still) before launch and said it was looking at similar quests (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/news/repeatable-quest-experience-exploit-fixed-for-wow-forever-launch-383574). At a 1-in-5 drop (classicdb), troll kills would be worth ~400 XP against ~285 for owlbeasts. If it pays, the judge should consider grinding the Altar of Zul trolls to ~49.3 here and dropping the 48.75→50 Thistleshrub grind in Tanaris (steps l08-064 and l08-065). Tanaris quests would still reach 50, and only Wastewander Justice loses 20%.

legs.title: Un'Goro, Felwood & Winterspring
legs.summary: Ride from Gadgetzan down into Un'Goro Crater and clear its quests in one figure-eight loop from Marshal's Refuge, then grind to 52. Hearth to Gadgetzan, take the boat to Riverglades and fly to Ironforge to train, then sail to Auberdine and ride through Ashenvale into Felwood. Quest Felwood south to north, earn just enough Timbermaw reputation to walk through Timbermaw Hold, finish in Winterspring (bind Everlook), and come back out through Felwood's hand-ins and the Auberdine boat to Stormwind at 55.
legs.why: Order follows Kopp's Classic 50–60 Un'Goro, Felwood and Winterspring sets (C), merged so each zone is visited once; all their quest ids exist unchanged in the Forever DB (wh.mjs, sweep-guides §B.5) and no Forever-new quests are listed for these zones. Un'Goro first because it borders Gadgetzan (leg 8's end) and its hub, Marshal's Refuge, sits in the north, so a loop SE (Torwa) → N (Marshal's) → NE → SE → S → W → Marshal's touches every objective once. Kalimdor has no Alliance warlock trainer (warcrafttavern), so one Eastern Kingdoms trip is forced; the Steamwheedle→Powderfuse boat and Farholde Keep flight path make it ~1 h. Kalimdor flight paths must be found on foot (foreverdb), so Felwood is entered once from Astranaar and worked south→north to Timbermaw Hold. The Timbermaw tunnel needs Unfriendly (Classic: start 2,500/3,000 Hostile, +5 per Deadwood kill), which Timbermaw Ally + Deadwood of the North + their kills just provide. In Winterspring, Donova Snowden's Winterfall chain is worth two tunnel round trips (~20k XP with Winterfall Runners, ~25 min), and leaving through the tunnel instead of flying Everlook→Talonbranch collects ~27k XP of Emerald Sanctuary hand-ins on the way to Astranaar. XP check (Classic quest XP from classicdb, Classic kill formula): quests and their kills give only ~332k of the 802,800 XP needed, so ~471k comes from five grind blocks (Fungal Rock, Lakkari Tar Pits, Deadwood north, Winterfall camps, Ice Thistle Hills). The Un'Goro grind is placed before the transfer so training 52 in Ironforge (a must-include) is possible.
legs.estTime: ≈ 24 h /played (our estimate: ~10 h of quests and travel plus ~14 h of grinding 471k XP at ~33k XP/h; range 20–29 h for 25–45k XP/h). The skeleton's 16.8 h assumed 48k XP/h, which this leg's quest supply cannot reach.

legs.end: Level 55.0, Stormwind, off the Auberdine boat. Hearth: Everlook (re-bind in Stormwind if logging out). Trained 50/52 (Ironforge) and 54 (Stormwind). Flight paths add Marshal's Refuge, Auberdine, Astranaar, Talonbranch Glade and Everlook. Nothing carried that must be turned in; optional carries for leg 10: The Everlook Report (6028, Chillwind Camp) and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff (6030, Light's Hope), plus Yuka Screwspigot (4324) if carried from leg 8.

openQuestions: XP shortfall (largest risk): on Classic quest values (classicdb) and the Classic kill formula, this path gives ~332k of 802,800 XP; ~471k (59%) is grinding, ~14 h at 33k XP/h. Leg 8 found the same (475k). Options for the judge: (a) add Azshara's Talrendis Point quests (reachable from Astranaar); (b) a Sunken Temple run with its Tanaris/Stormwind pickups, since the Riverglades transfer passes near the Swamp of Sorrows and Forever pays dungeon quests about 2×; (c) accept the grind.

Forever XP per quest is unknown: the Nov 2 notes 'adjusted experience values on various quests' without naming them. Grind rate above 40 is also unknown (higher creature HP since Nov 2; Voidwalker health about halved per launch players).

Timbermaw starting reputation: Classic guides say 2,500/3,000 Hostile and +5 per Deadwood/Winterfall kill (Warcraft Tavern, almarsguides); warcraft.wiki.gg (retail) says players start Unfriendly. If Forever starts at Unfriendly, the reputation check in l09-064 is not needed.

Crystals of Power needs 7 crystals of each of four colours before the pylon quests open. Spawn density in Forever is unknown (a launch-week forum reply says 'Rainbow Crystals Everywhere'), so the pylon loop (~18k XP) is optional.
Darkwhisper Gorge now leads into Mount Hyjal; we assume 'Discover Darkwhisper Gorge' (Strange Sources) still fires at Kopp's spot (~60, 73).
Boat and ride times: Steamwheedle → Powderfuse sailing, the Powderfuse → Farholde ride and the Menethil → Auberdine wait are untimed. The Nov 5 maintenance was meant to fix boats.

Optional carries, resolved by the route critic: leg 10 hands in The Everlook Report (l10-039) and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff (l10-069). Chillwind Horns and Return to Tinkee were removed from this leg: Chillwind Horns follows Felnok Steelspring, which follows Broodling Essence from Tinkee in the Burning Steppes (classicdb series; Wowhead Forever tooltips), so it can't be taken at 54. That moves ~5,450 XP into the l09-086 grind (about 10 min).
Leg 8 could buy a Mithril Casing at the Ironforge AH: it unlocks Chasing A-Me 01 parts 2–3 here (~10.5k XP for a short escort).
U'cha shows as a normal level-55 gorilla in the Forever DB; The Mighty U'cha is on the optional pylon loop, and l09-036 offers it as a ride-out alternative to the hearth.

Hearth bind (a speed option for the judge): the Everlook bind (a must-include) saves only ~2–3 min at l09-090. Binding Stormwind instead (tram from the Ironforge training stop, then the Stormwind Harbor ship to Auberdine) lets you hearth from the Emerald Sanctuary straight to Stormwind. That skips the Astranaar ride, the Auberdine flight and the boat (~12–18 min), for a net saving of about 8–13 min, and leg 10 binds Stormwind anyway (l10-003).

Winterfall Runners: the Forever DB spawn points run from the tunnel mouth past Donova toward Winterfall Village, and Classic players report they respawn at the tunnel mouth quickly. The step now waits for them north of Donova instead of riding east.

legs.title: Burning Steppes & the Plaguelands
legs.summary: Burning Steppes first: Morgan's Vigil's quests and The True Masters courier chain, then a Blackrock orc grind to 56. Train in Stormwind and ride to Chillwind Camp; clear Western Plaguelands' cauldron chain, loop Eastern Plaguelands once and finish the western chains on the way back. After training 58 in Stormwind, a second visit from Light's Hope wraps up Darrowshire and grinds the north-east Scourge to 60.
legs.why: Kopp's Classic 55–60 route is the backbone, minus the Silithus and Winterspring returns the skeleton cut (fork F18); all 41 key Kopp quests are unchanged in the Forever database and no zone here has a Forever-new quest (Wowhead sweep). The True Masters is a courier chain (Lakeshire → Stormwind → Lakeshire → Morgan's Vigil). Running it between the two Burning Steppes loops puts Ragged John on the second loop at Flame Crest instead of a separate ride. Grinding to 56 before leaving opens The First and the Last (needs 56), whose follow-ups (Flint Shadowmore, The Eastern Plagues, The Blightcaller Cometh, ~20k XP) all lie on this path. Kopp alternates five times between the two Plaguelands. Here the cauldron chain ends at Gahrron's Withering on the eastern border, and one anticlockwise loop of Eastern Plaguelands goes north first, so Caretaker Alen's quests are in the log before the Undercroft. It ends at Tirion, and the western chains (Darrowshire, Unfinished Business, termites) finish on the way back to Chillwind Camp. The only return is a Light's Hope-based visit after training 58. On Classic quest XP (Questie's Forever xpDB) the leg's quests give about 267k of the 975.8k XP needed (including leg 9's two Argent Dawn deliveries) and quest kills about 97k. The other ~612k is grinding, placed where it opens quests (56, 58) or where the mobs stay at your level (north-east Scourge at 58–60).
legs.estTime: ≈23–28 h /played solo (model: ~8 h of quests and travel plus ~1,900 grind kills ≈ 612k XP at 30–40k XP/h). One BRD run, rested XP and Well Fed food can cut 4–6 h. The skeleton's 18.2 h assumed ~54k XP/h, which solo play here cannot reach.
legs.start: Level 55.0, Stormwind (Slaughtered Lamb, after training 54; you came in on the Auberdine boat). Hearth: Everlook (re-bound to Stormwind in step 3). Trained 50/52 (Ironforge) and 54 (Stormwind). Flight paths include Lakeshire, Southshore, Ironforge, Aerie Peak, Farholde Keep and Everlook. Carrying from leg 9: The Everlook Report (Chillwind Camp) and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff (Light's Hope); optionally Yuka Screwspigot from leg 8.
legs.end: Level 60, Ironforge (Forlorn Cavern). Trained 56 and 58 (Stormwind) and 60 (Ironforge). Hearth: Stormwind, or Light's Hope if its innkeeper exists. Flight paths add Morgan's Vigil, Chillwind Camp and Light's Hope. Route complete.

steps.text: Start at the Slaughtered Lamb (Mage Quarter) at level 55, after leg 9's boat and training
steps.note: Your hearth is still Everlook and you trained 54 here at the end of leg 9. Everything below assumes Classic quest XP.

steps.text: Accept **A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!** from Crier Goodman

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

npcs.name: Crier Goodman
npcs.role: quest giver (walks the Trade District and Cathedral Square)

steps.note: He walks between the Trade District and Cathedral Square. You need this breadcrumb: without it Chillwind Camp won't offer Clear the Way.

steps.text: Make Stormwind your home at Innkeeper Allison
steps.note: At 56 you hearth back here from Morgan's Vigil to train and pick up The First and the Last.

steps.text: Fly to Lakeshire
steps.note: Measured at 1 min 53 s on launch week.

steps.text: Ride north out of Lakeshire, through the pass into Burning Steppes, then east along the road to Morgan's Vigil
steps.note: About 4–5 minutes on a 60% mount. The path up to Morgan's Vigil starts near 83, 63 in Burning Steppes.

steps.text: Learn the Morgan's Vigil flight path from Borgus Stoutarm

steps.text: Accept **Extinguish the Firegut** and **FIFTY! YEP!** from Oralius, and **Dragonkin Menace** from Helendis Riverhorn

steps.text: Kill 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres and 7 Firegut Brutes on Dreadmaul Rock

steps.text: At Flame Crest, accept **Tablet of the Seven** from Maxwort Uberglint and **Broodling Essence** from Tinkee Steamboil

steps.text: If you carried **Yuka Screwspigot** from Gadgetzan, hand it to Yuka in the Flame Crest cave

steps.text: Ride to the north-east dragonkin: zap Black Broodlings with the device, then kill them, the dragonspawn, wyrmkin and drake
steps.note: Fire the device at a broodling before you damage it; the kill then drops a Broodling Essence. You need 8.

steps.text: Follow the east wall south and finish 15 broodlings, 10 dragonspawn and 4 wyrmkin
steps.note: Solo: one elite at a time, Fear and Death Coil to stay alive, Drain Life to heal. Kopp calls it "soloable but cutting it close".

Fly to Lakeshire
Turn in **The True Masters** to Magistrate Solomon and accept the next part

Turn in **The True Masters** to Marshal Maxwell and accept the Ragged John step

Use the Temporal Displacer at the broken grain silos and kill 15 Temporal Parasites

steps.text: Turn in **A Matter of Time**; accept **Counting Out Time**

steps.text: Northridge Lumber Mill: kill 2 Scarlet Knights, 2 Scarlet Magi, 2 Scarlet Medics and 2 Scarlet Hunters
steps.note: Medics and hunters stand at the south end of the mill (51, 44).

steps.text: Place the termites in the barrel at the centre of the mill
Turn in **Unfinished Business**; accept part two
Kill Huntsman Radley, then Cavalier Durgen on top of the tower
steps.at: East of the mill / north tower

steps.text: Turn in **Unfinished Business**
steps.note: Part three needs a climb into Hearthglen past elites. Do it only if Hearthglen's tower is quiet (6,200 XP).

steps.text: Ride south and grind the Scourge in Andorhal until 10,150 XP short of 58
steps.note: Kopp's spot; finish the 15 Skeletal Fragments on the Acolytes and collect Scourgestones on the way. The two camp turn-ins (10,150 XP) then ding 58.

steps.text: Turn in the last **A Plague Upon Thee** and **Skeletal Fragments**
steps.note: Skip Mold Rhymes With (its turn-in is in Gadgetzan). Hand any Scourgestones to Argent Officer Pureheart for reputation.

steps.text: Hearth to Stormwind; if you bound at Light's Hope instead, fly to Stormwind via Ironforge

npcs.name: Bibilfaz Featherwhistle
npcs.role: flight master (if you bound at Light's Hope)

steps.note: The hearth has been ready since Morgan's Vigil, and you land at the Gilded Rose. If you did the cloth donations, A Donation of Runecloth (60 Runecloth, 6,600 XP) is at Clavicus Knavingham nearby.

steps.text: City Hall: give Janice's parcel to Royal Factor Bathrilor; accept **Good Natured Emma**
Find Ol' Emma and turn in **Good Natured Emma**
steps.note: Skip Good Luck Charm: Janice is back in Felstone Field and this route does not return there.

steps.text: Turn in **The Blightcaller Cometh** to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
steps.note: Skip Order Must Be Restored (raid).

steps.text: Train your level 58 spells in the Slaughtered Lamb
Fly to Light's Hope (Stormwind → Ironforge → Light's Hope); if you bound there, hearth instead
steps.note: Flight times on this route are not measured yet.

steps.text: Light's Hope: turn in **Uncle Carlin**, **Brother Carlin** and **Zaeldarr the Outcast**; accept **Defenders of Darrowshire** and **Villains of Darrowshire**
steps.note: Skip Heroes of Darrowshire: its libram is inside Hearthglen.

steps.text: Corin's Crossing: kill Gibbering Ghouls and talk to the Darrowshire Spirits that rise from them
steps.note: Cannibal Ghouls and Diseased Flayers free spirits too.

steps.text: Pick up the Shattered Sword of Marduk at the bottom of the gorge west of the crossing
steps.at: The Infectis Scar, west of Corin's Crossing

steps.text: Dive into Blackwood Lake for Horgus' Skull
Ride east and finish the 15 spirits on the Diseased Flayers north of the chapel
**Defenders of Darrowshire** and **Villains of Darrowshire** to Carlin Redpath
Before the long grind, eat Well Fed food; between sessions, log out in an inn
steps.note: Rested XP doubles kill XP and builds 5% of a level per 8 hours. Well Fed food adds 5% kill XP for about 15 minutes.

steps.text: Optional: Stratholme, Scholomance or Blackrock Depths with a group instead of part of the grind
steps.note: Kopp: "If you don't want to grind this large amount then do BRD, scholo, or strat." One run each at most; dungeon mob XP is cut in Forever, so the quests are the point.

steps.text: Grind the Scourge north-east of the chapel (Northpass and Eastwall towers) until 59
steps.note: These mobs stay at or above your level until 60. On Nov 2 Blizzard raised class damage and high-level creature health together, so Classic kill speeds may not carry over.

steps.text: Switch to the Mossflayer trolls at Zul'Mashar (or stay on the Scourge) and grind to 60
steps.note: Humanoids, so Fear works and they drop runecloth. Infiltrator Hameya (60) also walks here; leave him.

steps.text: Ride back to Light's Hope and fly to Ironforge
Train your level 60 spells in the Forlorn Cavern
steps.note: Level 60 adds Bane of Doom. The Dreadsteed chain (Dire Maul, group) is a post-route option.

steps.text: Level 60 — route complete
steps.note: Hearth: Stormwind (or Light's Hope if you bound there). Flight paths added this leg: Morgan's Vigil, Chillwind Camp, Light's Hope.

openQuestions: XP shortfall (biggest risk): on Classic quest XP and the Classic kill formula, about 612k of the leg's 975.8k XP must come from grinding (~1,900 kills; 15–20 h at 30–40k XP/h). The skeleton's 18.2 h is not reachable solo. Options for the judge: keep the optional BRD run (and Strat/Scholo at 58–60); put back Kopp's Silithus block at 56 (≈80% of a level) and his Winterspring block at 59 (≈45–50% of a level); or accept the grind.

Forever's final build 'adjusted' quest XP on various quests (Nov 2 notes, direction not stated). Every quest XP number here is the Classic value; nobody had reached level 55 by Nov 5 (leader 39.2 on race.aotc.gg).

Kill speed above 50 is unknown: on Nov 2 Blizzard raised class damage and, to compensate, the health of higher-level creatures, and cut pets to 2 Health per point of the warlock's Stamina (was 7.5). Dragonkin Menace (15 elites) gates The True Masters; whether a solo warlock can do it in Forever is untested.

Chillwind Camp has no innkeeper in the Forever databases (Wowhead, Questie), so the skeleton's 'bind Chillwind' is not possible. Light's Hope's innkeeper Jessica Chambers is in the Wowhead Forever DB but came with a late Classic patch: check in game.

Eastern Plaguelands' map seems to be re-cut in Forever: Questie's Forever data puts Tirion at 5.2, 35.6 and Light's Hope at 71.8, 49.6, where Wowhead (used here) has 7.4, 43.4 and 81.4, 59.2. Stormwind and Redridge use Wowhead's Forever-map set.

Unmeasured travel: flight times Stormwind↔Ironforge, Chillwind↔Ironforge and Light's Hope↔Ironforge, and the Southshore → Chillwind ride through Alterac (Kopp's Classic crossing at 80, 34; warcraft.wiki.gg lists Alterac's map as substantially changed in Forever, so that coordinate may not match).
The spec trains 56 in Ironforge; this leg trains 56 and 58 in Stormwind's Slaughtered Lamb because the quests take you there anyway. Same trainers, so no other leg changes.
BRD XP for Forever is a preliminary beta-forum estimate (~116k quest XP at 57); dungeon mob XP is cut and dungeon quests give 50% less extra XP (Oct 1 notes).
Cloth quartermasters (A Donation of Wool/Silk/Mageweave/Runecloth) are in the Forever DB, but nobody has confirmed them in game; if live, saved cloth is cheap XP in Stormwind and Ironforge.

Untested speed-up (recommended to the judge, not applied): Tirion's chain. Take Of Forgotten Memories at Tirion (step 79), kill Mercutio Filthgorger (57) and his three guards behind the Undercroft for Taelan's Hammer, and return to Tirion: 6,000 XP. Its follow-up Of Lost Honor (6,200) has its Symbol in Northdale, inside the 58–60 grind area. Turning it in at Tirion just before 60, then Of Love and Family (6,200) at Caer Darrow, and flying out of Chillwind instead of Light's Hope adds about 18k XP for an estimated 15–20 min. Kopp does the first two in Classic (VanillaGuide).

Light's Hope in the Forever database also has the Naxxramas-era turn-in NPCs (Rohan the Assassin, Huntsman Leopold, Korfax, Rayne, Archmage Angela Dosantos). Their first quests (e.g. Bonescythe Digs: 30 Bone Fragments) are 6,600 XP each in Classic data. They came with the same late Classic patch as the inn, and where the items drop in Forever is unknown; if the NPCs are there, check before the 58–60 grind.
Cross-leg, resolved by the route critic: leg 9 no longer accepts Chillwind Horns or carries Return to Tinkee (Chillwind Horns needs Felnok Steelspring, which needs Broodling Essence from this leg).
